name: Wagle Ki Duniya
description: Three generations of the family live together, who share all their happiness and sorrows. Follow the story of this family as they bring laughter to each other's lives and will make your heart melt. A new generation of the old critically acclaimed show is here to take you on a roller coaster ride of emotions.

videos.title: Singapore Ke Tickets - Maha Episode Part 1
videos.overview: Kittu is excited about her chances of going to Singapore after winning the award for the most unique Ganpati. Meanwhile, everyone in Pushpa's chawl starts to panic after Golu goes missing.

videos.title: Golu Pe Aarop - Maha Episode Part 2
videos.overview: The jeweller blames Golu and calls him a thief. However, Harshad comes to the rescue and takes him to Sai Darshan Heights. Will they be able to make sure Golu reaches home safe?

videos.title: New Generation Same Happiness
videos.overview: Rajesh calls his parents to tell them that I have fixed the time to move into their new flat in Borivali. Later, Rajesh visits the grocery shop but cannot choose the right coconut. So he calls his mother and Vandana to help him. Soon, everyone enters the new flat, and Rajesh's parents get teary-eyed to see that everything reminds them of their good old times.

videos.title: Shrinivas Has Lost His Sleep
videos.overview: Srinivas cannot sleep as he is missing his old place. He tries doing all kinds of routines, but nothing helps. Rajesh also gets troubled by this and comes up with a heart touching solution that comforts his father and puts him to sleep.

videos.title: Old Possessions - Treasure Or Trash
videos.overview: Srinivas wants to find the content of each of the cassettes that he has got in his collection. He calls Rajesh and texts Sheehan to arrange for a tape recorder to play these tapes. Radhika is grumpy about his habit of keeping old things as she thinks that all of it is useless.

videos.title: Vandana Can't Have Her Morning Coffee
videos.overview: Vandana has been working the entire day and missing upon having her morning coffee as she is occupied with looking after other members of the family. Her efforts seem to go in vain when Atharva returns with a weak report card.

videos.title: Rajesh's Valentine Dinner
videos.overview: Rajesh, along with his family, celebrates Valentine's Day at a fine Thai Restaurant. Rajesh gets tricked by the price of the restaurant menu and ends up receiving a huge cheque. Things get more troublesome for him when his credit card does not work.

videos.title: Society's Faulty Lift
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana notice that the lift in their society isn't working properly. Srinivas forgets his phone in the lift and Vandana and Radhika think he is stuck in there, while he is with his grandson playing carrom.

videos.title: Rajesh and His Curd
videos.overview: Vandana has been giving Rajesh a packed curd, which he does not like. When Radhika learns about it she gets perplexed as Rajesh was very fond of curd as a child. Radhika figures Rajesh likes homemade curd and tries to teach Vandana but Vandana feels belittled.

videos.title: Lehenga For Vandana
videos.overview: Jyoti comes to Wagle's house all glammed up and Vandana casually compliments her expensive lehenga. Rajesh thinks Vandana yearns for such a lehenga and with the help of Asha ends up paying for the first copy of a designer lehenga. Meanwhile, Joshipura thinks that Rajesh and Asha are having an affair.

videos.title: Atharva's Punishment
videos.overview: Atharva plays a prank on his vegetarian classmate, by feeding him a chicken sandwich. Rajesh believes Atharva needs to be taught a lesson and gives him a punishment to clean the toilets of his home and school.

videos.title: Rajesh In Police Custody
videos.overview: Rajesh Wagle’s scooter is found at a murder site. The police come to Wagle's house and to everyone’s shock they take Rajesh into police custody. He confesses the scooter was his.

videos.title: Rajesh's Expensive Gift
videos.overview: Rajesh cannot decide on a gift for his friend. Radhika gives him a gift-wrapped box that contains a pressure cooker which was gifted at their wedding. Radhika is unaware that she has accidentally dropped her gold chain in the pressure cooker. Will Rajesh clarify the confusion or will he end up gifting them a gold chain?

videos.title: Srinivas is Diabetic
videos.overview: Srinivas Wagle is diagnosed with high blood sugar, and Rajesh starts keeping a stern watch on his father's diet. When Radhika makes him understand that Srinivas feels helpless as he loves sweets, Rajesh thinks of a way to help his father.

videos.title: Fight Between Miya-Biwi
videos.overview: Rajesh gets incessantly asked questions about his whereabouts by Vandana, which sets him off and they get into a fight. Radhika decides to intervene and shares her wisdom with Vandana; everything she has learned in all these years, living with senior Wagle.

videos.title: The Wagles Locked Outside Their House
videos.overview: Forgetful Radhika and Srinivas are locked outside their house. The locksmith suggests that the lock needs to be broken. Atharva gets an idea and implements it without sharing it with anyone.

videos.title: Family Goa Trip Cancelled
videos.overview: Rajesh finds out that his fixed deposit of rupees 2 lakhs has matured and he plans a family holiday to Goa. However, Rajesh accidentally trips over Atharva's skateboard and sprains his ankle. The family decides to bring Goa to Mumbai by dressing up in Goan clothes and creating a lively atmosphere around Rajesh to cheer him.

videos.title: Rajesh's Dental Woes
videos.overview: Rajesh has severe pain in his tooth, but he is scared to visit the dentist. Vandana and Radhika try different home remedies to ease his pain. However, Rajesh realizes that these home remedies have sealed his mouth tightly.

videos.title: Father vs Daughter
videos.overview: Rajesh makes the mistake of provoking his daughter by telling her he is better than her because he is a man. She challenges him to a fair man-to-woman badminton match to put an end to the debate.

videos.title: Rajesh Declares A No Gadget Weekend
videos.overview: Everyone has to stay locked in a room when a beehive gets disturbed. Rajesh thinks this will be a good opportunity for the family to bond with each other and declares that no one will use their electronic gadgets.

videos.title: Srinivas Finds An Old Letter
videos.overview: Men have never been able to figure out what a woman wants. Will Srinivas and Rajesh be able to figure it out?

videos.title: Sweet Child Of Vandana
videos.overview: After Vandana gets irritated by Atharva's antics, he finds a way to make her smile.

videos.title: Women's Day Party
videos.overview: Rajesh takes his father to a medical camp in Igatpuri, which turns out to be a pleasant experience for him. Meanwhile, Vandana throws a party but doesn't invite Radhika. How does women's day turn out for the women of the family?

videos.title: The Lost Money
videos.overview: Rajesh finds twenty thousand rupees and makes it his life's purpose to return the money to its owner.

videos.title: World's Best Dad
videos.overview: Srinivas is proud to show off his trophy to the rest of the family. Unfortunately, the trophy breaks and he has an emotional breakdown.

videos.title: Shivratri At Wagle's
videos.overview: The kids want to go on a trip to Ajanta Ellora caves, but Vandana wants them to attend the Jagran. Rajesh comes up with a way to make the pooja fun and memorable.

videos.title: Trying Times For The Family
videos.overview: As expenses and prices keep rising, it becomes difficult for Rajesh to keep his family happy. However, these tough times won't stop them from loving and caring for each other.

videos.title: When Rajesh Needed His Family
videos.overview: After Rajesh loses his job, his parents and children come up with ways to cheer him up and become a pillar he can lean on.

videos.title: Baba Ka Coat
videos.overview: Radhika and Vandana, being the good citizens they are, plan to donate some clothes to the needy. However, their good deed becomes a nightmare for Srinivas.

videos.title: Rajesh's Stock Market Adventure
videos.overview: When Rajesh struggles to make ends meet, he decides to invest money in the stock market. However, things do not go exactly how he envisioned and he loses his sleep over it.

videos.title: Vandana's COVID Scare
videos.overview: Vandana is excited about attending her friend's wedding in Pune. However, all her plans may need cancelling as she catches a severe cold and cough.

videos.title: Channelling Atharva's Energy
videos.overview: After Atharva talks back to his mother, Rajesh steps in and puts him in his place. Rajesh feels that he has to find a way to channelise Atharva's energy.

videos.title: Importance Of A House Wife
videos.overview: After everyone takes Vandana for granted, Rajesh comes up with a fun game to keep a track of the daily chores everyone does for each other.

videos.title: Vandana's Matrimonial Profile
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana discover that someone has made a profile with Vandana's details on a matrimonial website. Soon, she starts receiving calls from men with marriage proposals.

videos.title: Sakhi Brings Home A Friend
videos.overview: Sakhi has a cool friend named Vivaan who comes home to teach her salsa. Rajesh, being a possessive parent, keeps an eye on him. Will Rajesh accept his daughter's friend?

videos.title: Vaccinating Srinivas
videos.overview: Srinivas is sceptical regarding the covid vaccine and denies taking the dose. Everyone tries to trick Srinivas to get the vaccine shot. Will he agree to take it?

videos.title: The Holi Horror
videos.overview: Rajesh reaches home to find Atharva already in the spirit of Holi that makes him and Vandana furious. Later, strange things happen around the society where people are assaulted if they are preparing for Holi.

videos.title: Who Is The Culprit?
videos.overview: Everyone tries to enjoy the Holi celebration as an unknown person is trying to spoil all the fun by assaulting innocent residents.

videos.title: Kya Khana Hai?
videos.overview: Atharva impresses his mother with his smart deductive abilities. However, she gets annoyed when she asks everyone about what they want to eat. They have the same reply that does not help Vandana at all.

videos.title: Know Your Limits
videos.overview: Rajesh plays pranks on everyone on account of April Fool's Day. However, he is taken for a surprise when a showbiz company plays a prank on him that scares the wits out of him.

videos.title: Nagarsevak
videos.overview: Srinivas comes across a pothole made on the road by a political party and notices a man falling into it. Agitated by this, he posts it on social media. What will happen now?

videos.title: Radhika And Vandana's Ad Shoot
videos.overview: An ad agency coordinator comes across Radhika and Vandana at a mall and it seems both the women are exactly what she is looking for. They get excited to know that they will be sharing the screen with Aryan the superstar. Will the shoot be as exciting as they expect?

videos.title: Vandana's Next Opportunity
videos.overview: Radhika and Vandana discover that the only thing visible in the ad is their hands scrubbing the dishes. The ladies are extremely upset and the men find it hilarious. Later, Vandana accepts Arnav's offer to work on a show.

videos.title: Vandana Scammed
videos.overview: Vandana, hard at work cooking food for everyone, does not realise that she is sharing the OTP with a fraud. Rajesh gets extremely angry at Vandana, who also feels guilt-ridden. Will they manage to catch the fraud?

videos.title: Rajesh's First Crush
videos.overview: Rajesh is reminded of his first crush, Madhura, who he fondly called Sakhi. After everything that has happened, Vandana and the kids feel that Rajesh should talk to her. How will Rajesh decide to deal with his past?

videos.title: Rajesh's Childhood Library
videos.overview: Rajesh learns that the library that he had spent most of his childhood in, is getting sold off. He also observes that his kids are least interested in books and lack cultural knowledge. He takes this opportunity to do something heartwarming for the kids and society.

videos.title: Trouble At The Resort
videos.overview: Rajesh takes his family to a resort for a vacation. However, Atharva still manages to spoil the mood with his tantrums. Rajesh comes up with a plan to teach him some manners.

videos.title: The Game Of Survival
videos.overview: Rajesh explains the rules of the game they will play at the resort. Everyone gets into the spirit of the game and learn a valuable life lesson in the process.

videos.title: All Rules And No Fun
videos.overview: Joshi arrives at the resort and starts imposing his rules and regulations on Rajesh and the hotel's management. Rajesh, at his wit's end, plans to chase him out of the resort.

videos.title: Sending Joshi Home
videos.overview: Joshi is still running around the resort and altering all the plans to his liking. Rajesh finally manages to get rid of him so they can celebrate Vandana's birthday as per their liking.

videos.title: Vandana Loses Jyoti's Jewellery
videos.overview: When Jyoti opens her jewellery box, she finds that her expensive earrings are missing. Since they were under Vandana's care, she feels guilty about losing them. Will Rajesh and Vandana manage to find the culprit?

videos.title: Nowhere To Go
videos.overview: Rajesh tries to help a couple who are visiting the resort for their wedding. However, Joshi isn't liking anything about their situation. Will Rajesh manage to find a way to help them?

videos.title: Atharva Is Not A Wagle?
videos.overview: Everyone constantly troubles Atharva and makes him feel unwanted. Atharva gets sad and starts to believe that he is not a part of the Wagle family.

videos.title: Atharva Meets His Family
videos.overview: Atharva is told that he is adopted but, everyone has always given him the love and affection that any son deserves. He discovers the truth about his real family and accepts them with all his heart.

videos.title: Mini Lockdown At The Resort
videos.overview: After multiple spotting of snakes at the resort, Joshi imposes a lockdown. Later a snake charmer is called with the hopes of capturing the snakes.

videos.title: Staying Healthy
videos.overview: Everyone gets into vacation mode and enjoys all types of unhealthy food at the resort. Vandana takes it upon herself to make sure that Rajesh stays healthy by eating a proper diet.

videos.title: Vandana The Chef
videos.overview: Rajesh gets excited to find that the quality of food at the resort has improved. Soon, Rajesh starts to investigate the reason for this improvement.

videos.title: Power Cut At The Resort
videos.overview: Sakhi's Nobel project, which is due by the end of the day, is interrupted due to a power outage at the resort. This does not stop her from completing the project.

videos.title: Raaz Chupane Ki Saajish
videos.overview: With everyone's morale running low Rajesh and Vandana plan to throw a special party. However, Joshi is deadset to find out what Rajesh and Vandana are planning.

videos.title: Atharva's Ultimatum
videos.overview: Atharva gets extremely annoyed by how his parents treat him. He asks them to decide whether he should behave like a child or as an adult.

videos.title: Jaisi Karni Waisi Bharni
videos.overview: Rajesh accepts Atharva's challenge and both begin their mind games to win the competition. Both father and son go beyond limits to prove that they are right, but everyone learns a valuable lesson by the end of it.

videos.title: Celebrating Atharva's Success
videos.overview: Jyoti invites everyone to her wedding anniversary, but there are some terms and conditions applied. Later, Atharva reveals that he has done well academically and Rajesh thinks it calls for a celebration.

videos.title: Jyoti's Secret
videos.overview: Vandana discovers Jyoti is having late-night conversations with someone else. Is there someone in her life?

videos.title: Rajesh And Vandana's Fight
videos.overview: In the middle of Jyoti and Harshad's crisis, Rajesh and Vandana bring out their issues in front of everyone. What could be the reason behind this outburst?

videos.title: Food Smuggling
videos.overview: Rajesh finds out that the resort's staff has been smuggling food out of the resort. Find out how this mystery ties up to the knot on Vandana's dress.

videos.title: Atharva's Rich Dreams
videos.overview: Atharva gets tired of adjusting to a sub-standard life which infuriates his mother. He believes that when grown-ups do not have the answers to their questions they tend to over-react. Will Vandana manage to teach him the real meaning of happiness?

videos.title: The Joy-O-Meter
videos.overview: Vandana promises Rajesh that she will use a tactic similar to him to teach Atharva an important life lesson. She gives Atharva an instrument to play whenever he feels happy.

videos.title: Sakhi Ki Zidd
videos.overview: Sakhi thinks she is old enough to try new things and experiment in her life. Will Vandana and Rajesh manage to stop her from making any mistakes?

videos.title: The Ladies Night Out
videos.overview: Dakshesh and Harshad trouble their wives to the extent that they decide to have a ladies night. The men get curious to know what their wives are talking about and spy on their conversation.

videos.title: Women United
videos.overview: The ladies discover the phone that their husbands planted and make a pact to never reveal their discussion to them. The husbands use all the tricks so they can get their better halves to talk.

videos.title: The Cycle Race
videos.overview: Rajesh and Harshad get into an argument about who is a better cyclist. They decide to have a race and settle the debate once and for all.

videos.title: The Warriors Are Ready
videos.overview: Vidyut and Rajesh are against the competition as it has taken the fun out of cycling. However, Atharva and Harshad are excited about the war and demand an expensive new cycle if they win.

videos.title: Atharva Won't Back Down
videos.overview: Atharva has trouble accepting defeat and gets upset. He resorts to physical violence that results in both families turning against each other. Will Rajesh manage to resolve the matter?

videos.title: Jyoti's Secret Courier
videos.overview: Jyoti requests Rajesh to deliver a suitcase back to her home in Mumbai. Everyone is shocked when they see the contents in the case.

videos.title: Role Reversal
videos.overview: Everyone gathers at the resort to play a game. Rajesh suggests that they play a game of "What-If'.

videos.title: Helping Rajesh Meet Monica
videos.overview: Rajesh is anxious to meet Monica and rectify his mistake. Everyone at the resort decides to help him reach his school friend.

videos.title: Sakhi's New Obsession
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana notice drastic changes in Sakhi's behaviour at the resort. How will Rajesh help Sakhi to be happy again?

videos.title: The Best Friend Day
videos.overview: Everyone celebrates the day by reconnecting with their best friends. However, Rajesh is upset as he is not in touch with his closest friend.

videos.title: Atharva's Nightmares
videos.overview: Rajesh has trouble sleeping due to Atharva's nightmares. Sakhi plans to counsel her brother before Rajesh calls for professional help.

videos.title: Harshad's Trick
videos.overview: Harshad teaches the kids a trick that angers Rajesh. The Wagles, upset from this, decide to skip dinner with everyone. Will their friendship end for good?

videos.title: Vandana's Headache
videos.overview: Vandana has been experiencing a severe headache that has troubled her for several days. Afraid that it might be something serious, she consults a doctor through an app.

videos.title: Vandana Unwell
videos.overview: Vandana keeps drowning in the false information that is available in abundance on the internet. Rajesh supports her at this time and makes her see the light.

videos.title: Fish Pond Ka Raaz
videos.overview: Vandana gets everyone excited about playing a game of fish pond together. The game brings some buried secrets out in the open.

videos.title: Atharva's Lottery
videos.overview: Atharva and Vidyut find ten thousand rupees at the resort and plan to treat themselves. Rajesh stumbles onto their party and decides to teach them some morals.

videos.title: Vidyut's Tragedy
videos.overview: Atharva finds out a sad story about Vidyut and seeks help from Rajesh. They confront the resort's owner, who makes their trouble double.

videos.title: Rajesh's Chipkoo Movement
videos.overview: Rajesh bands everyone together for a chipkoo movement to save the trees from the owner's plan. When things start to look grim, Rajesh and Vandana come up with another plan to motivate everyone.

videos.title: Yoga Day
videos.overview: Everyone at the resort gets ready for Yoga day. Rajesh teaches the importance of Yoga to Atharva. How does this fitness enthusiasm go for the Wagles and their neighbours?

videos.title: Sakhi's Crush
videos.overview: Sakhi meets Randeep Walia at the resort, who is shooting for a TV show. When Rajesh discovers that they are spending time with each other, he does what any protective father will do.

videos.title: Sakhi In Distress
videos.overview: Randeep takes a distressed Sakhi to his room to spend some time. When Rajesh reaches Randeep's room he finds something very shocking.

videos.title: Getting Older
videos.overview: Soon after Rajesh finds a picture of his favourite actress getting older, Vandana finds a grey hair. How will the couple adjust to getting older?

videos.title: Atharva's Silence
videos.overview: Atharva, whose mischiefs have tortured the entire society, decides to keep quiet. His behaviour has his family worried.

videos.title: Atharva's Demands
videos.overview: Atharva sees Vidyut get a resort membership and asks for the same from his parents. Vandana is completely against the idea of bending down in front of his demands but Rajesh considers buying him the membership.

videos.title: Vahem Hota Hai
videos.overview: The manager informs about the paranormal activity that has been going on inside room number 13. Rajesh decides to check it out with Harshad and Dakshesh.

videos.title: Rajesh Faces Bhootni
videos.overview: Rajesh regrets taking the challenge to prove about ghosts. Will he manage to find out the truth about the ghost?

videos.title: The Missing Masala
videos.overview: The first rain at the resort calls for a joint tea party. When Dakshesh finds out that the tea masala is missing, he begins his investigation.

videos.title: The Ideal Son
videos.overview: Rajesh worried about his parents, meets an old couple in the resort. He goes out of his way to help them, not knowing they are hiding something.

videos.title: Rajesh Helps Mr and Mrs Dev
videos.overview: Rajesh asks for twenty-four hours from the old couple to find a way to help them. Later, the old couple goes missing, and everyone searches every corner of the resort for them.

videos.title: Swimming Pool Ke Maggarmachh
videos.overview: Harshad and Dakshesh decide to take a dip in the swimming pool. The police arrive at the pool and apprehend them for breaking the COVID regulations.

videos.title: Rajesh Angry With Harshad
videos.overview: Rajesh expresses his anger towards Harshad for his behaviour around children. He calls everyone and tells how children get easily influenced.

videos.title: Qissa Fatte Joote Ka
videos.overview: Rajesh, Harshad and Dakshesh agree to race for the last piece of pastry. Rajesh's shoe gets torn and the story takes an interesting turn.

videos.title: Resort Se Vidaai
videos.overview: The news of the lockdown getting lifted spreads quickly. Everyone tries to come up with an appropriate amount to tip the resort's staff.

videos.title: Anjaane Aaye Ghar Pe
videos.overview: Rajesh and his family finally arrive at their flat in Mumbai. With them, a few masked men with an evil agenda also enter into their society.

videos.title: Catching The V Gang
videos.overview: The robbers' terror keeps growing in the society. Everyone decides to band together with the police to end their schemes once and for all.

videos.title: The Robbery Suspects
videos.overview: The police start apprehending suspects so they can be questioned. Will the culprit be caught?

videos.title: Angry Young Man
videos.overview: Atharva talks rudely to his father. Rajesh gets angry and plans to do something about it.

videos.title: A Shocking News
videos.overview: Rajesh has an intriguing customer at his office. Vandana receives a letter that delivers a piece of shocking news.

videos.title: Anhoni Bani Aafat
videos.overview: Rajesh informs everyone about resigning from his job. Vandana hides a fact from Rajesh that comes back to haunt the family.

videos.title: Surprise For Rajesh
videos.overview: Rajesh's family asks him to calm down and tackle one problem at a time. Meanwhile, Rajesh's new boss is preparing to surprise him.

videos.title: Rajesh's Decision
videos.overview: The new CEO permits Rajesh to take an important decision for himself. Vandana asks Dakshesh a question that leaves him speechless.

videos.title: Late Lateef
videos.overview: The Wagles get invited to an engagement ceremony. Rajesh plans to reach on time and change his image of never being punctual.

videos.title: Hichki Ka Raaz
videos.overview: The Wagles begin their day with Sai Aarti as they celebrate Guru Purnima. Rajesh believes that there exists a mystery behind his unstoppable hiccups.

videos.title: Rajesh Ki Hichki
videos.overview: Dakshesh tries to find a way to help Rajesh with his hiccups. Atharva tries to act smart, but Rajesh sets up an intricate plan to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Repairs At Sai Darshan
videos.overview: The construction men working on Rajesh's building have everyone worried. How will Rajesh react when he finds out that they are disrupting his family's privacy?

videos.title: The Peeping Tom
videos.overview: One of the construction workers peeps into Sakhi's room. She gets angry when Rajesh and Vandana decide to double-check the situation before escalating the situation.

videos.title: The Ageing Parents
videos.overview: Rajesh requests his mother to get a proper medical check-up done. However, Radhika is adamant that she is fine and she ends up making her problem worse.

videos.title: The Conjunctivitis Outbreak
videos.overview: Harshad has to go to his cousin's place alone as Vidyut acquires conjunctivitis. The members of Sai Darshan get scared of Vidyut's condition.

videos.title: Vidyut Opens Up
videos.overview: Vidyut shares the truth with Rajesh, and Vandana, and the real reason behind him avoiding his uncle. This shocks the couple. What did Vidyut say?

videos.title: Harshad Gets To Know
videos.overview: Harshad gets to know about his friend and his horrendous acts. Will he believe the society members or take his friend's side?

videos.title: Little Things In Life
videos.overview: Senior Wagle teaches a life lesson to his son and asks him to appreciate every moment as if it was the last. Rajesh takes the cue and decides to surprise his father with a gift. What did Rajesh get?

videos.title: The Garbage Man
videos.overview: Harshad has an issue with the garbage man using the lift in the society while the garbage man refuses to use the stairs. How do the society members come to a conclusion?

videos.title: Papa Ko Mat Batana
videos.overview: Rajesh gets worried when he comes home in an inebriated state and worries that senior Wagle will find out that he is drunk. Will he be able to hide his secret from his father?

videos.title: Kab Tak Chupega Raaz?
videos.overview: Everyone gets involved in the act of trying to hide Rajesh's drunken state from his father. But wherever there is Dakshesh, nothing works according to plan.

videos.title: Teesri Leher
videos.overview: Radhika's secret plan of going to her village's temple to feed the poor scares Rajesh. He is worried that the third Covid-19 wave might hit, and going there would put everyone's lives at risk.

videos.title: Sakhi Ka Kamra
videos.overview: Sakhi visits Anvita's house for a night stay to complete a project and is fascinated by her personal space. On her return she requests a room from her parents.

videos.title: Sakhi Learns A Life Lesson
videos.overview: Sakhi gets stuck in a slum during heavy rainfall and learns a valuable life lesson.

videos.title: Remembering Freedom Fighters
videos.overview: Atharva gets a project from school to make a presentation on freedom fighters and independence day. He asks Sr. Wagle for help because he wants to do something unique. What lesson does Atharva learn along the way?

videos.title: Vandana With A Baby
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana think they are pregnant with a child. The pregnancy scare makes them reevaluate their choices and decisions.

videos.title: Vandana's Doctor Visit
videos.overview: Vandana and Rajesh visit a gynaecologist for her check-up. All the members of the family give their support to Vandana and promise to care of her.

videos.title: Lag Gayi Shart
videos.overview: Atharva and Rajesh get into an argument about who contributes more towards the household. Who will win the gentleman's challenge to prove their contribution to the family?

videos.title: Rajesh And Atharva's Challenge
videos.overview: Rajesh and Atharva are zealous to prove that one is more hardworking than the other. They work harder and smarter than ever before to win the challenge.

videos.title: Radhika Misses Her Brother
videos.overview: Srinivas scolds Radhika for planning to visit her brother, who insulted the family during Rajesh's wedding. Rajesh comes up with a plan to ease the tension in their relationship.

videos.title: Anna In Mumbai
videos.overview: Anna arrives in Mumbai a day earlier to surprise everyone. How will Rajesh handle the situation after making those calls to him?

videos.title: Anna Meets Srinivas
videos.overview: Anna, after reaching Mumbai, immediately wants to meet his brother-in-law. How will Srinivas react when he finds out that he has been betrayed by his son?

videos.title: Rakhi Mein Archan
videos.overview: Radhika and Anna reunite after 18 long years. Will they celebrate the occasion of Rakshabandhan without any hurdles?

videos.title: Anna Prepares For Departure
videos.overview: Rajesh, feeling guilty about the situation, helps Anna to prepare for his departure. Will Rajesh find a way to mend Anna and Srinivas' relationship.

videos.title: Janmashtami Jagran Preparation
videos.overview: All members of the society gather to prepare for the Janmashtami celebration. The police, in an angry mood, arrives at Harshad's house.

videos.title: Rajesh And Gang Arrested
videos.overview: Rajesh and his group of friends get locked up by the police for gambling. They ask the police for a phone call. Will they manage to get out?

videos.title: Kitchen Ka Kaam
videos.overview: Rajesh takes up the role of helping Vandana in the kitchen but ends up becoming more of a liability than a help. How will this experience change Rajesh?

videos.title: Learning How To Cook

videos.overview: Asha meets with an accident. Later, the doctor tells Asha that her policy is invalid and she must pay in advance for her husband’s treatment. What will she do now?

videos.title: Bad News For Dilip
videos.overview: Hospital people tell Rajesh that they can’t give a cashless facility to Asha. Later, Harshad and Dakshesh offer to help Asha and her husband.

videos.title: Entrepreneur Atharva
videos.overview: Sakhi tells her parents that Dakshesh is organising a fitness camp. Later, Atharva and Vidyut start a new company.

videos.title: Atharva's Business Plan
videos.overview: Atharva and Vidyut keep a business proposal in front of Harshad. Later, Srinivas talks to Atharva and Vidyut about their business and Atharva gets an idea.

videos.title: Padhai Ki Ehemiyat
videos.overview: Rajesh scolds Atharva and Vidyut for forgetting about their morals to run a business. Rajesh asks Harshad to not support Atharva and Vidyut’s business. Later, Atharva and Vidyut decide to leave school.

videos.title: Nick Ke Expensive Shoes
videos.overview: Vidyut and Atharva ruin Nick’s expensive shoes. Nick asks them to pay him for ruining his shoes. Later, Vidyut and Atharva find a solution to fix Nick’s shoes which are also very expensive. What will they do now?

videos.title: Sakhi's Report
videos.overview: Rajesh plans Sakhi’s birthday party. Sakhi goes to the hospital with Gungun. Later, Gungun finds out that Sakhi is pregnant. What will happen now?

videos.title: Sakhi Ki Confusing Report
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana are worried about Sakhi and wonder where they went wrong as parents. Vandana and Rajesh confront Sakhi and scold her. Later, Atharva asks Vandana to check the name on the report.

videos.title: Sakhi Takes Care Of Her Friend
videos.overview: Sakhi saves Sakhi Warge from committing suicide. Sakhi and her friends keep an eye on Sakhi Warge. Later, Sakhi follows Sakhi Warge's boyfriend to find out the truth.

videos.title: Sakhi Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Manoj hits Sakhi Warge’s boyfriend, Anand. He warns everyone that it is dangerous to get in the bad books of politician Ratan Lal’s son. Later, Sakhi Warge tells the truth about her pregnancy to her parents. How will Sakhi help Sakhi Warge now?

videos.title: Hukum Ka Ikka
videos.overview: Sakhi shows the video she shot of Anand to Sakhi Warge to convince her that Anand is not a good man. Sakhi’s family finds out that politician Ratan Lal’s men have a murder case on them. Later, Ratan Lal’s men have something which they can use to blackmail Sakhi Warge.

videos.title: Sakhi Ki Himmat
videos.overview: Ratan Lal's men use Sakhi Warge's video to blackmail her. Sakhi stands by her friend and motivates her to lodge a police complaint. Will the police help Sakhi Wagre get justice?

videos.title: Aapki Sakhi
videos.overview: Rajesh asks Ratan Lal to let the police do their job. Sakhi decides to start an initiative on social media for the girls who go through a similar situation as Sakhi Warge. Later, Vandana and Jyoti decide to enter a beauty contest.

videos.title: Confident Jyoti
videos.overview: Vandana gives Jyoti a confidence potion to help her become more confident. Harshad is shocked to see the change in Jyoti. Later, Jyoti and Vandana practice for their beauty contest.

videos.title: Andar Ka Confidence
videos.overview: Gungun and Sakhi get shocked to see Jyoti's overconfidence. Harshad refuses to attend the beauty contest. Later, Jyoti learns the truth about the confidence potion. Who will win the contest now?

videos.title: Pani Don
videos.overview: Jyoti gives an honest and amazing answer to the judges in Hindi. Later, Atharva and Radhika get a waterborne parasite infection and they try to change their building’s water tankers. Will Pani Tai let them make this change?

videos.title: Rajesh Stands Against Pani Tai
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Pani Tai that the source from where she’s getting the water tanker filled is contaminated. Rajesh finds out that someone broke some part of the building motor machine. Later, Manoj asks Rajesh to not go against Pani Tai.

videos.title: Vandana In Danger
videos.overview: Rajesh tells his colleagues that he has filed a PIL against Sachveda Builders. Sachveda and Pani Tai see Rajesh’s interview and get furious. Later, Pani Tai kidnaps Vandana. What will happen now?

videos.title: Paani Re Paani Tera Rang Kaisa?
videos.overview: Despite Rajesh's attempts to persuade them, the members of the society refuse to file a complaint against Pani Tai. However, at that moment, Sakhi and the other children of the society put on a skit, enlightening the members about the significance of clean water. Will Rajesh and the others succeed in their battle against Pani Tai?

videos.title: Dakshesh Ka Apman
videos.overview: Dakshesh announces that he is going to launch a book for his poems. Dakshesh thinks Harshad threw his shoe at him. Will he find out who insulted him?

videos.title: Dakshesh's Shoeless Journey
videos.overview: Dakshesh continues his shoeless journey as he tries to figure out who threw a shoe at him. How will this journey teach him things he had previously ignored?

videos.title: Joota Kisne Maara?
videos.overview: Dakshesh continues on his quest to narrow down on the person who threw a shoe at him. Will he be able to catch the culprit?

videos.title: Vandana The President
videos.overview: Vandana becomes the president of the parent's association and takes up their issues with the school administration. Will she be able to resolve them?

videos.title: Vandana Ki Pheli Complaint
videos.overview: Vandana goes to Atharva’s principal with other parents’ complaints. Later, Rajesh tells Vandana that her complaint to the board can affect his company’s growth.

videos.title: Maa Ki Nazar
videos.overview: Vandana brings Ranjit’s mentor to talk to Ranjit about the school’s policy regarding expensive shoes. Later, Atharva and Vidyut ask Kittu to not play with them.

videos.title: Harshad's Ex Lover
videos.overview: Sakhi finds a way to get Atharva and Vidyut to speak the truth. Later, Harshad does something horrible. What has he done?

videos.title: Harshad Ka Affair
videos.overview: Harshad secretly starts talking to his ex-lover, Trupti. Jyoti suspects something is wrong with Harshad. Later, Trupti asks Harshad to do something to prove his love for her.

videos.title: Scam Calls
videos.overview: Harshad is disturbed thinking about the scam that happened to him. Harshad gets blackmailed by an unknown number. What will Harshad do now?

videos.title: Harshad Is Disturbed
videos.overview: Jyoti is worried for Harshad because he’s acting strange and wants to know what’s troubling him. A man imitates a police inspector and calls Harshad and tells him the girl he was talking to is dead. What will Harshad do now?

videos.title: Scam The Scammer
videos.overview: Manoj meets the scammer as Harshad and asks for more time to arrange the money. Later, Rajesh comes up with a plan to expose the scammer. Will they be successful?

videos.title: Rajesh's Foolproof Plan
videos.overview: Rajesh and Manoj try to expose the scammer and his whole team. Rajesh imitates a police officer to get the scammer to speak the truth. Later, Harshad goes on TV to confess his mistake.

videos.title: Alag Divisions
videos.overview: Vandana scolds Atharva for his bad report card while Atharva and Vidyut find out that they both have been put in different class divisions. Kiara and Rajesh tell their employees about the employee exchange programme. Later, Vandana receives other parents’ complaints regarding the class division.

videos.title: Atharva And Vidyut's Protest
videos.overview: Vandana tries to convince everyone that the school’s decision to keep Atharva and Vidyut in different divisions is good for them. Atharva and Vidyut decide to not eat or drink anything. Later, Rajesh learns about his employees’ plan to ruin the employee exchange programme.

videos.title: Sakhi Deserves More
videos.overview: Atharva apologizes to Vandana and understands her and his teacher’s perspective. Atharva and Vidyut work out a plan to meet each other in school. Later, Sakhi feels bad because Vivaan avoids her and she decides to let him go.

videos.title: Sabka Favourite Pulkit
videos.overview: The wives behave salty towards their husbands because of Pulkit. Later, they set up Pulkit’s house and play table tennis with him. Rajesh, Dakshesh and Harshad decide to expose Pulkit’s truth.

videos.title: Rajesh Is Fed Up
videos.overview: Everyone tries to figure out why Pulkit got divorced. Rajesh finds out that Vandana has invited Pulkit over for breakfast and decides to invite Vivaan also. Later, Rajesh shares a plan with Harshad and Dakshesh to expose Pulkit.

videos.title: Pulkit Ki Kahani
videos.overview: Everyone watches Pulkit’s violent side and gets shocked. Pulkit’s ex-wife Riya tells the truth to everyone and the reason for her divorce from Pulkit. What is Pulkit’s truth?

videos.title: Rajesh Ki Video Hui Viral
videos.overview: Everyone gets emotional listening to Pulkit’s story and apologises to him. Later, Kiara records a video of Rajesh when he gives a pep talk to his co-workers and the video gets viral.

videos.title: RJ Raju
videos.overview: Vandana motivates Rajesh to pursue his dreams. Rajesh goes to Light Greem FM studio and gets a part-time job offer. Later, RJ Jolly gives an orientation to Rajesh.

videos.title: Apka Apna Raju
videos.overview: Everyone gives a surprise to Rajesh but he tells them that he is not going to become an RJ. Rajesh’s colleagues set up a video podcast for him at the office. Later, Kiara’s mother fixes her marriage with someone.

videos.title: Manoj Ka Akelapan
videos.overview: Rajesh sees a bad dream about his parents while Manoj asks his mother to come and live with him. Later, Vidya, Manoj’s neighbour shares her feelings with him.

videos.title: Maa Baap Se Bichadne Ka Gam
videos.overview: Rajesh asks Radhika to go and live with Manoj. Vandana tells Rajesh that Srinivas and Radhika can’t stay away from each other. Later, Rajesh asks his father to also go with Radhika.

videos.title: Rajesh Ka Sacrifice
videos.overview: Rajesh forces his parents to live with Manoj because he realises that he has always supported him. Srinivas tells Radhika that Rajesh is going to give their house on rent.

videos.title: Ghar Suna Ho Gaya
videos.overview: Manoj comes to pick up his parents but Radhika wants to wait till Rajesh comes home. Later, Nick is worried to meet Kiara’s mother.

videos.title: Compatibility Check
videos.overview: Nick tells Kiara’s mother that he wants to live with Kiara before marriage as friends. Radhika talks to Vidya about Manoj’s marriage. Later, Rajesh gets emotional talking to his parents.

videos.title: Haunted Ghar
videos.overview: Dakshesh doesn’t allow Nick and Kiara to live together as they are not married. Later, Dakshesh, Rajesh and Harshad decide to drink together and Dakshesh takes them to a haunted apartment. What will happen now?

videos.title: Chotte Bacche Ka Bhoot
videos.overview: Rajesh’s colleague tells everyone about a ghost of a little boy named Mumiya while Yamini tells all the ladies different horror stories. Later, Vandana’s maid sees Mumiya and gets scared.

videos.title: Badli Hui Sugandh
videos.overview: Everyone is scared of Mumiya. Sakhi realises that all the ladies drank orange juice which had alcohol in it. Later, Atharva develops a disease where he can’t smell anything right.

videos.title: Atharva Aur Vidyut Ki Job
videos.overview: Vidyut and Atharva decide to join a job but the owner asks them a get a letter from their parents. Later, Atharva forges Rajesh’s signature on his letter when Rajesh refuses to listen to him. What will Rajesh do when he finds out about it?

videos.title: Fraud Atharva
videos.overview: Vandana and Rajesh find out about Atharva and Vidyut’s jobs and Vandana scolds him for manipulating everyone. Later, Atharva tells Vandana that he can’t smell anything right. What is wrong with Atharva?

videos.title: Srinivas Ke Mann Ki Baat
videos.overview: Rajesh tells his parents that going to a psychologist shouldn’t be a taboo and Srinivas sits for therapy himself to show Atharva that it is normal. Later, Atharva sits for therapy. What will happen now?

videos.title: Rajesh Ka Kharab Din
videos.overview: Atharva feels much better after the therapy while Vandana realises that she must carefully choose her words when angry. Later, Rajesh tells Vandana that he had a very bad day.

videos.title: Rajesh's Fortune
videos.overview: Nick and Kiara plan to make an important announcement regarding Rajesh's future. Srinivas and Manoj get into an argument over the poor condition of their home. Later, Rajesh sees the fortune teller once again, and he feels that something bad is about to happen.

videos.title: Rajesh Ke Liye Difficult Decision
videos.overview: Manoj sees Vidya’s son Mangesh doing something suspicious and creates a scene. Rajesh tells everyone that if he wants a 50% increment in his job, he has to leave Mumbai and go to Indore. What will happen now?

videos.title: Rukne Ke Reasons
videos.overview: Vivan shares his relationship problem with Sakhi and asks her to never leave him alone.  Kiara and Nick tell Rajesh that for the company’s betterment, he has to go to Indore. Will Rajesh leave this opportunity to stay in Mumbai?

videos.title: Indore Nahi Jana
videos.overview: Atharva’s new friend asks him to stay in Mumbai. Rajesh’s parents wish him well and give him permission to go to Indore. Later, Sakhi and Atharva tell their parents that they don’t want to leave Mumbai.

videos.title: Chawl Ki Buri Condition
videos.overview: Manoj says repairing the chawl is essential, while Rajesh asks Manoj about the chawl’s redevelopment proposal. Later, Kiara tells Rajesh he has only one week to shift to Indore.

videos.title: Meeting Mein Dikkat
videos.overview: Vidya and Radhika find a way to stop Srinivas and Kulkarni from attending the meeting. Later, Sakhi and Mangesh wake Srinivas and Kulkarni at the time of the meeting. What will happen now?

videos.title: Corrupt Builder
videos.overview: Rajesh handles a crisis very maturely. Srinivas tells Manoj there’s no need for Chawl’s redevelopment. Later, Sakhi follows Mangesh because she sees him doing something suspicious while Manoj talks to a builder.

videos.title: Chawl Ki Barbadi
videos.overview: Vandana and Rajesh’s friends keep a going away party for them. Srinivas and Kulkarni talk about Manoj’s good qualities while the chawl starts breaking down. What will happen now?

videos.title: Srinivas In Danger
videos.overview: Srinivas is nowhere to be found. Pushpa and her family go to help Rajesh’s family. People blame Manoj for the Chawl’s destruction.  Later, Rajesh and Manoj look for Srinivas.

videos.title: Manoj Ke Khilaf Proof
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana look for Sakhi. The hospital tells Manoj that Srinivas is no more. Later, Mangesh sends Manoj’s video to all news channels which proves that he is behind the Chawl’s destruction. What will happen now?

videos.title: Srinivas Ko Laga Shock
videos.overview: Srinivas wakes up, and he asks about Kulkarni. Srinivas finds out that Manoj has been arrested for the Chawl’s destruction. Later, Manoj tries to convince the police that he is innocent.

videos.title: Aadha Video
videos.overview: Vandana meets Manoj at the police station while Sakhi and Harshad try to look for Srinivas’ phone which has proof that Manoj is innocent. Later, the police take Mangesh to the police station.

videos.title: Mangesh Ka Natak
videos.overview: Rajesh asks Vidya to bring Mangesh and come and live with them. A lady from the Chawl is crying and worried because someone stole her jewellery. Who stole her jewellery?

videos.title: Mangesh Ne Chhupaye Gehne
videos.overview: Dakshesh doesn’t allow Manoj and Vidya to stay together in the building because they are not married. Manoj tries to find a place to sleep at night. Later, Dakshesh shows a video to Rajesh and Harshad of Mangesh digging a hole in the garden.

videos.title: Vandana Ki Tabyat
videos.overview: Rajesh wants to take Mangesh to the police station for stealing jewellery. Mangesh decides to run away with the money. Later, everyone discusses whether Manoj and Vidya should get together or not.

videos.title: Shaadi Ki Zimmedari
videos.overview: Vidya’s father asks Vidya to get married to Manoj. Radhika tells Manoj that Vidya is ready to marry him. Later, Mangesh says he doesn’t want Vidya to marry Manoj. What will happen next?

videos.title: Vandana Ki Bimari
videos.overview: Vandana goes to see her doctor to find out if she has cancer. The doctor asks her to get more tests done to be sure. Later, the Wagle family plans Vidya and Manoj’s wedding.

videos.title: Vandana Ki Reports
videos.overview: Vandana gives back her ancestral necklace to Radhika so she can give it to Vidya. Vidya wonders whether she deserves to be a part of the Wagle family. Later, Vandana gets her biopsy report result. Is Vandana going to be okay?

videos.title: Shaadi Wala Ghar
videos.overview: Rajesh’s budget for the wedding exceeds his actual budget. Vandana hides the truth about her disease from everyone. Later, Mangesh messes with Sakhi’s phone while two thieves plan to rob Rajesh.

videos.title: Paise Gayab
videos.overview: Two thieves follow Rajesh while he looks for a rickshaw. Rajesh finds out that he lost the bag with the money while Vandana’s health worsens. What will happen now?

videos.title: Vidya Ke Mamaji
videos.overview: Manoj hides from Vidya’s relative because he has a bad history with him. Vivaan reads Adtiya’s messages on Sakhi’s phone. Later, Vandana is worried about putting more burden on Rajesh by telling him about her disease.

videos.title: Sangeet Function
videos.overview: Vandana gets worried thinking about her disease. Vidya tells Manoj that her ex-husband knows that she is getting married. Later, Rajesh tells the police about his stolen money while Vandana’s doctor asks her not to waste more time.

videos.title: Rajesh Ki Duniya Hil Gayi
videos.overview: Rajesh finds out that Vandana has cancer and he confronts her. Mangesh thinks about spoiling Vidya’s wedding while Vandana tells Rajesh she knows about the stolen money. What will happen next?

videos.title: Stalker Ka Khulasa
videos.overview: Vivaan gets to know that Sakhi’s stalker, Adtiya is present at the sangeet function. Vandana and Rajesh go to Kiara’s house. Later, the person who has Rajesh’s money finds out that the police are looking for him. What will be his next move?

videos.title: Chamatkar Ya Imaandari?
videos.overview: A miracle happens and Rajesh gets back his bag full of money while Manoj and Vidya’s haldi function is going on. Later, Vidya’s husband creates a scene at her wedding and asks her to give him money. What will happen now?

videos.title: Vandana Ki Bimari Ki Khabar
videos.overview: Everyone gets shocked when they find out that Vandana has cancer. Later, Jyoti and Damini ask Vandana to promise them that she will tell them if she ever needs anything. How will Vandana fight this disease now?

videos.title: Badalta Bartav
videos.overview: Manoj blames his bad destiny for all the wrong that is happening in the family. Vandana’s neighbours’ behaviour changes towards her which makes her feel even worse about her situation. What will Vandana do now?

videos.title: Vandana's PET Scan
videos.overview: Vandana gives her blood sample for a PET scan which makes Rajesh anxious. Later, Vandana and Rajesh wait desperately for Vandana’s blood test result.

videos.title: Baccho Ki Struggle
videos.overview: Dakshesh and Harshad get into a fight when Harshad tells him he wants to put his flat on rent. Sakhi doesn’t want Vivaan to know about her mother’s disease. Later, Vandana goes for a PET scan.

videos.title: Mangesh Hai Solution
videos.overview: Vandana gets her PET scan done while Harsahd looks for a paying guest. Mangesh tells Harshad he knows someone who needs a place to stay. Later, Atharva and Sakhi prepare healthy food for Vandana.

videos.title: Chori Ka Paisa
videos.overview: Vandana feels nauseous after breakfast, and Rajesh decides to call the doctor. Meanwhile, the police arrive at Sai Darshan Heights Society, and they want to arrest Harshad's new tenant, Ranjeet.

videos.title: Harshad Got Scammed
videos.overview: Harshad and Dakshesh realise that they got scammed. Vandana creates a short video for Sakhi and Atharva which makes Atharva emotional. Later, Dakshesh finds proof against the thieves.

videos.title: Vandana Ka Resignation
videos.overview: Manoj catches the thieves but the thieves attack him. Rajesh decides not to go to Indore and stay with Vandana while Vandana resigns from the school president’s post and encourages Jyoti to take the position. What will Jyoti do now?

videos.title: Tough Decision For Vandana
videos.overview: Srinivas doesn’t support Manoj’s decision to start a business. Jyoti stands against Mrs Chopra for the president’s post. Later, the doctor suggests Vandana should get a mastectomy. What will happen now?

videos.title: Mastectomy Ki Khabar
videos.overview: Vandana tells her kids that she’s going to have a mastectomy. Jyoti’s family discourages her when they find out that she wants to become Vidyut’s school’s president. Later, Rajesh does a podcast and asks Vandana to listen to it.

videos.title: Atharva Ki Curiosity
videos.overview: Jyoti decides to give the interview for the school president. Rajesh and Vandana spend quality time together. Meanwhile, Atharva gets caught watching objectional content on his phone. What will happen now?

videos.title: Rajesh Misunderstands Sakhi
videos.overview: Manoj gets upset with Srinivas' piece of advice about his business. Vidyut realises his mistake and supports his mother. Later, Rajesh misunderstands Sakhi based on Manoj's word.

videos.title: Vandana Ka Treatment
videos.overview: Vandana’s relative finds out that Vandana has cancer while Vandana’s family is worried about Vandana’s treatment money. Later, Manoj finds out that he got scammed.

videos.title: Radhika Ko Aya Attack
videos.overview: Jyoti’s tutor gives up and runs away while Vidya tells Manoj how Vandana’s relative mistreated Radhika and she got Alzheimer’s attack. Later, Rajesh asks Vandana’s relative, Sudha not to tell Vandana about the breast implant plan.

videos.title: Atharva's Gift
videos.overview: Vandana motivates Jyoti before the school president's elections. Later, Atharva brings a thoughtful gift for Vandana before her surgery.

videos.title: Jyoti Jeet Gayi
videos.overview: Jyoti becomes the president of the parents association of the school. Manoj is worried about selling his machines. Later, Vandana goes to the hospital for her surgery. What will happen next?

videos.title: Mummygiri
videos.overview: Vandana goes for her surgery without knowing she’s also going to get implants today. Ten days later, Vandana comes back home and everyone welcomes her with lots of love and support.

videos.title: Badhta Kharcha
videos.overview: Dakshesh tells Rajesh that he has asked everyone to do an RT PCR test before entering the society. Later, Vandana finds out how much Rajesh spent on her treatment and decides to get a job. Will she get a job easily?

videos.title: Society Mein Magic Show
videos.overview: Dakshesh wants to learn magic from the magician staying in their building. Mangesh takes advantage of Radhika’s disease and scams her. Later, everyone attends Akshay Laxman’s magic show.

videos.title: Wagle Catering Company
videos.overview: Dakshesh converts Harshad into a pigeon while Vandana tells her clients that she has expanded her company where she has hired more people to help her. Will she get work now?

videos.title: Rajesh Ka Loan
videos.overview: Jyoti thinks something bad has happened to Harshad. Manoj blames Mangesh for stealing one of his coffee machines while Vidya goes missing. Later, the building watchman gets a man who can help Dakshesh find Harshad.

videos.title: Manoj Ki Maafi
videos.overview: Manoj gets in trouble while trying to sell one of his coffee machines. The person Rajesh owes money doesn’t go easy on him. Later, Manoj tries to apologise to Vidya.

videos.title: Manoj Aur Vidya Ka Alone Time
videos.overview: Dakshesh fails to turn the pigeon back into Harshad which he had done with the help of the magician. Later, Vandana makes a plan with Sakhi to get Manoj and Vidya to spend some quality time together. Will their plan work?

videos.title: Jung Abhi Jaari Hai
videos.overview: Jyoti says that Dakshesh will go to jail for kidnapping Harshad while Dakshesh tells everyone the truth. Later, Vandana’s family decides to go with her for her chemo sessions. Is Vandana going to be okay?

videos.title: Vandana Ki Chemo Journey
videos.overview: Aradhana tells Vandana about misconceptions people have about cancer and gives her hope. Vandana gets a big order but she thinks about turning it down. Later, Vandana finds a way to fight her fears.

videos.title: Sakhi's Gift To Vandana
videos.overview: Everyone gets emotional when they see Vandana’s bald look. Vandana gives a surprise to Rajesh. Later, Rajesh is stressed about his loan money. What will he do now?

videos.title: Impressive Jyoti
videos.overview: The people who bought the coffee machine from Vidya return it back to her while Jyoti’s practical points impress the school principal. Later, Rajesh finds out he can’t take Harsahd’s help for money. What will he do now?

videos.title: Choro Ke Ghar Chori
videos.overview: Vidya asks for Dakshesh and Harshad’s help with the coffee machines while Vandana feels guilty when she finds out that Rajesh is having money problems because of her. What will happen next?

videos.title: Order Ke Liye Paiso Ki Zaroorat
videos.overview: Sakhi thinks there’s something going on between her father and Madhura. Vandana doesn’t have enough money to complete her order while Rajesh is trying to sell his car. What will happen next?

videos.title: Rajesh Ki Majboori
videos.overview: Rajesh tries to sell his car to arrange for some money. Jyoti, Yamini and Dakshesh help Vandana prepare for her order, but she runs into another obstacle.

videos.title: Rajesh Ki Car
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Vandana that he’s thinking about selling his car. Kumar refuses to pay Vandana for her services. Later, Rajesh sells his car for money. What will happen now?

videos.title: Bye Bye Cancer Cells
videos.overview: Srinivas has symptoms of PTSD. Vandana finds out that Rajesh sold his car. The doctor asks Vandana to take radiotherapy. Later, kids at school bully Vidyut because of Jyoti.

videos.title: Chawl Ki Pareshani
videos.overview: Manoj and Srinivas tell the Chawl people that they are going to help them while Atharva finds out about Rajesh’s new car. Manoj brings a politician who promises to take care of the Chawl people. What will happen now?

videos.title: Redevelopment Ka Process Chalu
videos.overview: Atharva wants to help his parents in some way. Manoj talks to a politician about Chawl’s redevelopment while Dakshesh finds out about Mangesh’s plan to claim his grandfather’s money. What will happen now?

videos.title: Atharva Ka Money Test
videos.overview: Atharva asks Harshad not to tell Rajesh about the money he’s borrowing. The Wagle family spend quality time with each other. Later, Vandana gives advice to a girl named Ananya, who is suffering from cancer.

videos.title: Atharva Aur Vidyut Ka Secret Mission
videos.overview: Atharva makes a plan with Vidyut to earn money. Everyone in the chawl gets a notice to leave the chawl. Later, MManoj finds out that Mukesh is working with politician Vishnu. What will happen now?

videos.title: Dadar Ke Papers
videos.overview: Manoj and Rajesh stand against Mukesh and Rajesh tells Manoj he still has the Chawl papers but he gave them to Radhika. Later, Atharva gets a small funding for Vandana’s treatment. What will happen now?

videos.title: Atharva Ko Mila Bada Donation
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Manoj that he stopped the chawl people from singing on Vishnu’s papers. Atharva gets a big donation from an unknown person while Dakshesh plans to get a big order for Vandana.

videos.title: Police Is Looking For Atharva
videos.overview: Vandana gets a big order, while Rajesh faces a problem at work and decides to stay at the office overnight. Later, the police come looking for Atharva. What has Atharva done now?

videos.title: Atharva Ki Questioning
videos.overview: The police officer takes Rajesh and Atharva to the police station for questioning. Vandana gets stressed thinking about Rajesh and Atharva while Atharva tells the police about the truth.

videos.title: Bete Ki Galati Ka Natija
videos.overview: Jyoti drops Vandana’s catering order food while the police officer interrogates Atharva and puts pressure on him. Later, Radhika asks Vandana why is Atharva upset. What will she tell her?

videos.title: Atharva's Call Recordings
videos.overview: Vivaan’s friend Roy tries to help Atharva and Rajesh by retrieving the call recordings from Atharva’s phone. The police officer tells Vandana that he’s keeping Rajesh in his custody to protect him. What will happen next?

videos.title: Aslam Ka Parda Faash
videos.overview: Srinivas and Radhika talk to Rajesh on video call. Shakeel from the bank tells the police about Aslam and where they can find him. Later, Kiara scolds Rajesh for being unprofessional.

videos.title: Sponsorship Chahiye Hai
videos.overview: Vandana tells Atharva she is proud of him for thinking about his family. Dakshesh says that they don't have funds for dandiya night so Vandana suggests they should get sponsors. Will everyone be able to get sponsorships?

videos.title: Vivaan And His Father's Equation
videos.overview: Kiara gives permission to her employees to celebrate dandiya raas in the office. Vivaan gets into a fight with his father. Later, Vivaan tells his father that he wants to stay in India and work in AI. Will his father agree to this?

videos.title: Mangesh Ka Pyaar
videos.overview: Sakhi and Vivaan practice together for Forum Patel’s dandiya function. Mangesh also decides to go with Sakhi and Gungun. Later, Dasani does a mix-up at the office which puts Rajesh in trouble.

videos.title: Dandiya Night At Sai Darshan Heights
videos.overview: Dakshesh asks everyone to clap for Vandana, Jyoti and his wife for collecting sponsors. Dakshesh finds out that everyone lied to him about the sponsors. Later, Sakhi decides to confess her love to Vivaan.

videos.title: Negativity Ka Ravan Dahan
videos.overview: Sakhi arrives at the coffee shop to confess her love for Vivaan. Meanwhile, Rajesh receives Vandana's medical reports. Will the reports bear good news for Vandana?

videos.title: Sunday No More Funday
videos.overview: Rajesh and Dakshesh are upset because Vandana has cancelled their Sundays and asks Dakshesh to keep an eye on them. Why has Vandana created this new rule?

videos.title: Mardon Ka Sunday
videos.overview: Rajesh finds his colleagues in the office on Sunday and is shocked. Vandana takes Kiara’s help in keeping Rajesh in the office while Rajesh and Harshad come up with a plan to enjoy their Sunday.

videos.title: Bachchan Ji Ki Charcha
videos.overview: Everyone talks about Amitabh Bachchan and how lovely it would be to meet him. Later, they pray to god as they want to be invited to ‘Kaun Banega Crorepati’.

videos.title: Kaun Jayega KBC Mein?
videos.overview: Rajesh tells everyone that he and his family got invited to KBC but only three of them can go. How will they decide who should go?

videos.title: Wagle Family On KBC
videos.overview: Everyone is excited that the Wagle family is going to appear on KBC and decides to watch them on television. Later, Amitabh Bachchan welcomes the Wagle family on KBC.

videos.title: Wonderful Wagles Ki Jeet
videos.overview: Members of the Sai Darshan Heights society congratulate the Wagle family for their appearance on KBC. Meanwhile, Nick calls Rajesh for some relationship advice.

videos.title: Important Documents
videos.overview: Rajesh encourages his single colleagues to get married while Manoj tells Rajesh that they are going to get rich but Radhika accidentally burns their important papers. What will happen now?

videos.title: Radhika Ki Bigadti Yaadash
videos.overview: Green luggage which has important documents is nowhere to be found and Radhika blames herself for losing it. Later, Rajesh and Vandana are worried about Radhika’s deteriorating health.

videos.title: 6 BHK Flat
videos.overview: Manoj looks for 6 BHK flats and speaks rudely to Dakshesh and Harshad when they ask Rajesh not to leave Sai Darshan Society.  Later, The flat Radhika likes is out of their budget. What will happen now?

videos.title: Ek Choti Si Condition
videos.overview: The kids in the Wagle family don’t want to live under one roof. Later, Sakhi says she, Atharva and Mangesh are ready to live with everyone under one condition. What is her condition?

videos.title: Experiment Hua Chalu
videos.overview: The Wagle family starts living together under one roof and pretends they have no neighbours and friends in the building. Is this experiment going be smooth or troublesome?

videos.title: The Perfect Joint Family Picture
videos.overview: Vandana faces challenges living under the same roof as Manoj and the others. Will the Wagle's joint family experiment work?

videos.title: Diwali Ki Safai
videos.overview: Srinivas tells everyone that Radhika no longer wants to live together with everyone in a 6 BHK flat. Later, all the men do not want to help their wives in cleaning their houses for Diwali.

videos.title: Bhai Ka Pyaar
videos.overview: Badhresh disinvites Harshad from his party. The Wagle family wakes up before sunrise on Narak Chaturdashi. Later, Yamini misses her brother. Will he come to meet her?

videos.title: Harshad Banega High Profile
videos.overview: Senorita Kapur tells Harshad that she can help him throw an even bigger party than Badhresh while Dakshesh tells Yamini’s brother he is ready to give him what he wants. What has he promised him?

videos.title: Harshad Ke Fayde Ki Party
videos.overview: Mangesh and Atharva dress up as Manoj and Rajesh and put up a skit in front of Radhika. Senorita asks Harshad not to invite their neighbours to his party. What will Harshad do now?

videos.title: Yamini's Brother
videos.overview: Harshad keeps finding excuses to come back to his friends’ Diwali party. Yamini’s brother comes to meet Yamini on Bhai Dooj. What will happen when Yamini finds out about Dakshesh’s promise to Yamini’s brother?

videos.title: The Exchange Student
videos.overview: Karen asks Rajesh to stop supporting Manoj financially. Later, Manoj apologises to Rajesh and Sakhi smiles thinking about Karen. Does she like him?

videos.title: Ghar Aya Mehmaan
videos.overview: Atharva second-guesses his decision to share his room with the exchange student from Germany. Later, Karen asks awkward questions to everyone at the breakfast table.

videos.title: Sakhi Aur Karen Ki Dosti
videos.overview: Rajesh and Atharva want to get rid of Karen as soon as possible while Sakhi gets closer to Karen. Later, Vivaan feels jealous when he sees Sakhi with Karen together.

videos.title: Karen Ki Hindi
videos.overview: Karen and Sakhi try to make Atharva understand that only studying all day won’t benefit him. Later, Sakhi is surprised to see Vivaan at her house.

videos.title: Karen Ko Padhi Daant
videos.overview: Karen asks Rajesh to stop supporting Manoj financially. Later, Manoj apologises to Rajesh and Sakhi smiles thinking about Karen. Does she like him?

videos.title: Karen Ki Beautiful Video
videos.overview: Vivaan confronts Sakhi over feeling neglected. As Karen prepares to depart for Germany, he shares a touching video with the entire Wagle family. Later, Karen confesses his love to Sakhi.

videos.title: Harshad Ka Nuksaan
videos.overview: Harshad is shocked when he finds out that a society member threw a pot at his car, causing damage to the windshield. Will Sai Darshan Heights Society members find the one responsible?

videos.title: Kisne Feka Gamla?
videos.overview: Everyone's puzzled about the flowerpot thrown at Harshad's car. Manoj and Vidya inquire with Radhika and Srinivas about a possible fight between Mangesh and Harshad. Is Mangesh behind this flowerpot incident?

videos.title: Tiwari Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Harshad and Dakshesh attempt to convince Rajesh that Tiwari is behind the flowerpot incident. Subsequently, Tiwari is arrested by the police. How will Rajesh respond to this turn of events?

videos.title: Majboori Ka Fayeda Uthana
videos.overview: Tiwari tells everyone why he took money from Walia and covered the lie. Later, Harshad and Dakshesh talks about old age.

videos.title: Rajesh's Weak Eyes
videos.overview: The Wagle family watches the cricket match together and cheers for India. Rajesh apologises to Dakshesh and Harshad. Later, Vandana asks Rajesh to get his eyes tested.

videos.title: Rajesh's Poor Vision
videos.overview: In a challenging moment, Rajesh, hindered by poor vision, struggles to deliver a speech without reading from the paper. Later, Rajesh’s friends and family organize a surprise party for him.

videos.title: Street Dog Ki Musibat
videos.overview: Harshad gets bitten by a street dog, and he is worried about getting infected with rabies. What will the society members do to help him?

videos.title: Street Dogs Kaha Jaye?
videos.overview: After the street dog attacks Dakshesh, he wants all the street dogs to be banned from society. However, Harshad wants to keep a certain street dog close.

videos.title: Dakshesh Calls For A Meeting
videos.overview: Dakshesh calls a community meeting to discuss Harshad keeping a street dog in the society. Will the others be able to convince him to reconsider?

videos.title: Rajesh Needs To Suit Up
videos.overview: Rajesh's boss insists on him donning a suit for a crucial meeting with a British company, but Rajesh doesn't own one. Can he resolve this wardrobe predicament in time?

videos.title: Suit Mein Chitthi
videos.overview: Rajesh and his family members try to figure out the cryptic message found in the suit. Will they be able to decipher it?

videos.title: Mystery Of The Note
videos.overview: Rajesh and his family decipher the enigmatic message within the note, discovering that the numbers inscribed correspond to an insurance policy.

videos.title: Insurance Ka Laalach
videos.overview: Rajesh and his family find out that Babulal's son is only interested in money and has no true intention of taking care of his mother. Will they be able to expose him?

videos.title: Sabse Keemti Tohfa
videos.overview: Atharva wishes to gift something expensive to Vidyut for his birthday, but Vandana and Sakhi decide to convince him to give him something special instead. Later, Vandana and Yamini try to console Asha, who is hurt by something said to her by Jyoti.

videos.title: Nazar Ka Mamla
videos.overview: Vidyut falls sick and Jyoti believes that it is because of someone's evil eye. How will the Wagles deal with her superstitions?

videos.title: Atharva Exposes Joy's Doings
videos.overview: Atharva tells everybody about the incident that took place with Vidyut at school. Atharva then exposes Joy's doings. Later, the Wagles play a game at home.

videos.title: Rajesh Decides To Go To Indore
videos.overview: Rajesh decides to go to Indore for work and attempts to convince his family members about the same. Later, Rajesh's family and the society members extend their support as Rajesh leaves for Indore.

videos.title: Ekk Din Ki Responsibility
videos.overview: Vandana shouts at Atharva for being irresponsible and not caring about money being wasted. On Vidyut's advice, Atharva decides to become responsible for a day and fill in Rajesh's shoes. Will Atharva succeed in this attempt?

videos.title: Nick Aur Kiara Ka Rishta
videos.overview: Vandana and Sakhi figure out that Nick and Kiara are going through a rough patch as they seem to be constantly fighting. Will their differences get sorted?

videos.title: Nick Plans A Date
videos.overview: Kiara suspects that Nick is cheating on her with a girl named Supriya. Later, Kiara and Nick decide to live together and plan to get married soon.

videos.title: Baccho Ki Khushi Ke Liye Manjao
videos.overview: Kiara's mother and Nick's sister engage in a conflict. Subsequently, Rajesh, Vandana, Harshad, and Jyoti attempt to mend the rift between them. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Exam Question Paper
videos.overview: Atharva and Vidyut's principal discovers exam question papers in their bags. How did this happen?

videos.title: Question Paper Kisne Diya?
videos.overview: Everyone thinks Manoj gave the question papers to Atharva and Vidyut while Manoj tries to protect Mangesh. What will happen next?

videos.title: Injustice Ke Khilaf Ladai
videos.overview: Fueled by a sense of justice, Atharva and Vidyut decide to prove their innocence. How will they do it?

videos.title: Radhika's Night Out
videos.overview: Vidyut and Atharva prove their innocence and celebrate with their family members. Later, Kishori convinces Radhika to spend the day with her at her house.

videos.title: Radhika Is Lost
videos.overview: Concern grips everyone as Radhika is nowhere to be found, and to add to the worry, she can't recall her own address. What will happen next in this situation?

videos.title: Radhika At An Old Age Home
videos.overview: Rajesh asks the auto driver about Radhika's whereabouts and informs the inspector. Radhika arrives at an old age home and continues to grapple with memory loss, unable to recall anything.

videos.title: Mobile Chupana Hai
videos.overview: Rajesh finally finds Radhika and takes her home. Dakshesh asks Vandana to hide a mobile phone at her house. What is so special about this phone?

videos.title: Phone Ka Addiction
videos.overview: Atharva confronts Vandana about her mobile phone addiction, and Kittu's parents express disappointment over her low grades. Soon, everyone finds themselves grappling with an escalating issue of phone addiction.

videos.title: Kittu Can't Concentrate
videos.overview: Kittu struggles to focus on her studies, leading Sakhi to recommend consulting a child psychologist. Meanwhile, Vandana successfully overcomes her phone addiction. What will happen next?

videos.title: Kittu Ki Therapy
videos.overview: Yamini and Dakshesh are worried as Kittu has not returned home. Sakhi reveals that she took Kittu to a child psychologist. Later, Manoj suspects that Mangesh is stealing money from Radhika. What will he do now?

videos.title: Musical Mehfil Ki Tayaari
videos.overview: Rajesh tells Vandana he’s coming back home. Vandana arranges a musical mehfil function for Rajesh. Later, Vandana is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Vandana Is Missing
videos.overview: The police launch a missing person investigation for Vandana, unaware that she has been admitted to a hospital. What happened to Vandana?

videos.title: Vandana Calls Rajesh
videos.overview: Vandana gets confused when an unknown family calls her Shobha and insists on her calling her husband. What will happen next?

videos.title: Thali Bhog
videos.overview: The children eagerly inquire why Dakshesh isn't taking them to indulge in the delightful Rakumar Bhog Thali. With hunger mounting and anticipation building, everyone wonders about Dakshesh's whereabouts.

videos.title: Fraud Hua Hai
videos.overview: The kids gather food for everyone while Harshad suspects Dakshesh of a major fraud. Is Dakshesh genuinely involved in any fraudulent activities?

videos.title: Dakshesh Ki Galati
videos.overview: The society members question Dakshesh about how he got the money into his account. Meanwhile, Sakhi refuses to be a part of Vivaan and Anvita's dance video.

videos.title: Cool Mom - Vandana
videos.overview: Worried about Sakhi's movie outing, Vandana tries to be cool by suggesting a spa day. Later, Vandana and Atharva discover Sakhi is not being truthful. What is she hiding?

videos.title: Solo Date
videos.overview: Gungun reveals Sakhi's new boyfriend to their friends, but Sakhi remains discreet. Later, Vandana opens up to her psychiatrist friend about the challenges she's encountering with Sakhi.

videos.title: Rude Salesman
videos.overview: Vidya joyfully announces her new job, but Mangesh notes she'll out-earn Manoj. Vandana updates Rajesh on recent events, while facing an unpleasant encounter with a rude salesman, Vandana, Jyoti, and Sakhi find themselves in a challenging situation.

videos.title: Vandana Aur Sakhi Ka Protest
videos.overview: Rajesh discloses a significant financial setback to Kiara and Nick in their company. Manoj's debt to Tiwari draws rebuke from Srinivas. Meanwhile, Vandana and Sakhi stage a protest outside Gold Fusion.

videos.title: Sabko Sath Lekar Chalna Hai
videos.overview: Rajesh's colleagues fear that they might lose their jobs. Vidya surprises with gifts. Later, Rajesh proposes an alternative to downsizing to Nick. What is Rajesh’s idea?

videos.title: Legal Notice For Vandana
videos.overview: Harshad decides to take the help from Srinivas to file his income tax returns. Later, the owner of Gold Fusion Supermart decides to send a legal notice to Vandana for her viral video against his store.

videos.title: Mushkil Faisle
videos.overview: Vandana tries to avoid trouble, but Khurana demands a new apology video. Dakshesh supports her in facing the case. Later, Kiara tells Nick and Rajesh that their funding request has been rejected.

videos.title: Vandana's Lawyer - Dakshesh
videos.overview: Khurana's lawyer prevails in court, leaving Dakshesh unable to defend with valid points. Rajesh, moved by his hardworking employees, requests Nick to delay their termination. Dakshesh later questions Khurana about his advertising practices in court.

videos.title: Rajesh Leaves His Job
videos.overview: Rajesh's family shares news about a consumer protection group for the society, but he's troubled by the impending termination of three employees. In a decisive move, Rajesh opts to resign from his job instead.

videos.title: Rajesh Is Unemployed
videos.overview: Rajesh fears revealing he left his job. Vandana shares her catering business success and her expansion plans with Rajesh. Meanwhile, Sakhi announces her new job, making Rajesh wonder if she knows about his recent employment decision.

videos.title: Vandana Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Vandana plans to expand her cloud kitchen and she would need 4-5 lakh investment. Unable to reach Rajesh, she calls Dasani and grows suspicious due to conflicting responses from his colleagues. Later, Rajesh finally reveals the truth to Vandana. How will she react to this?

videos.title: Rajesh's Job Offer
videos.overview: Manoj is upset by Rajesh's job loss. Meanwhile, Rajesh gets a lucrative offer from P2P Max's rival if he agrees to share Nick and Kiara's trade secrets with them. What will Rajesh do?

videos.title: Rajesh Ki Loyalty
videos.overview: Sakhi prompts a man to clean up after spitting paan, and Rajesh decides against applying to courier companies, prioritizing integrity over compromise at P2P Max. What will Rajesh do now?

videos.title: Follow Your Dreams, Rajesh!
videos.overview: Harshad and Srinivas disclose that Srinivas works at Harshad's office. Encouraged by his family, Rajesh pursues his dream of becoming a singer. Later, Rajesh practices music early, waking up everyone.

videos.title: Rajesh Ka Riyaz
videos.overview: Rajesh struggles to practice his music but gets annoyed with his family making a lot of noise at home.  Later, he plans a family surprise and shares some good news.

videos.title: Rajesh Needs A Guruji
videos.overview: Rajesh confesses his audition fear to the family. Yamini suggests him getting a music teacher. Harshad's flat interests a guruji, but a clash ensues. Later, Rajesh seeks musical guidance from guruji.

videos.title: Rajesh's Successful Audition
videos.overview: Rajesh impresses everyone at the audition after practicing with Pandit Ravindra. However, the Pandit reveals his displeasure about losing a student to the film industry, leaving Rajesh distressed, especially since he, too, went in for an audition. Will Rajesh be able to hide this truth from his guru?

videos.title: Rajesh Gets Caught Lying
