videos.overview: Rajesh faces distraction during lessons with Guruji. Vidya suggests a Sunday outing, but Manoj doesn't have enough money. Later, Rajesh interrupts his lessons with Guruji to attend auditions, and he gets caught.

videos.title: Rajesh Ke Auditions
videos.overview: As Radhika faints, Srinivas contacts Rajesh, who's busy with auditions. Despite initial nerves, Rajesh attends three auditions. Later, Rajesh tells Vandana about his auditions.

videos.title: Zaroorat Aur Shaukh
videos.overview: Rajesh intentionally botches his audition, but expresses gratitude to his supportive family. Rajesh’s new friends suggest they all form a band together. Later, Harshad gets stuck in a cupboard, and Jyoti is locked in a bathroom. How did this happen?

videos.title: Do Do Tenants
videos.overview: Harshad attempts to convey to his tenant that he can't rent the flat, but struggles. Jyoti faces a similar challenge. Sakhi steps in with a solution, offering a way for both Harshad and Jyoti to avoid rejecting their prospective tenants for the flat.

videos.title: Vandana Becomes A Healer
videos.overview: Harshad and Jyoti encounter a predicament when tenants Zareen and Farad risk crossing paths in the same flat. Seeking assistance, they turn to Rajesh's house, where Sakhi offers a clever solution to navigate the challenging situation.

videos.title: Inka Milna Likha Tha
videos.overview: Jyoti is locked in the bathroom, and Harshad is stuck in a cupboard in their tenants' flat. Meanwhile, Zareen and Farad turn out to be eachother’s ex-lovers. Later, Vandana steps in to mediate and resolve the conflicts between the couple.

videos.title: Atharva's Accident
videos.overview: Rajesh rushes to the hospital when he finds out about Atharva's accident. A lawyer named Jimmy convinces Atharva to fake an injury so that they can sue Digvijay Dewan for money. Will Atharva agree?

videos.title: Jimmy Ka Fraud
videos.overview: The police come to Rajesh's place to take Atharva's statement. Rajesh aims to send Digvjay Dewan to jail for negligence in driving. Later, Dakshesh tries to record Jimmy's confession to fraud.

videos.title: Bade Hokar Kya Banana Hai?
videos.overview: Atharva admits lying about Digvijay Dewan and Rajesh is disappointed in Atharva. Atharva and Vidyut share about their school aptitude test with their mothers. The kids later discuss their future aspirations.

videos.title: Kushal's Ambitions
videos.overview: Kushal's father reduses to accept his ambitions and aspirations as he believes that him being a doctor is the best career path for him. Will the Wagles be able to convince him to change his views?

videos.title: Jyoti's Confidence Shakens
videos.overview: Judges announce Kitchen Ka Champion results while Rajesh encourages kids to choose their own future. Later, Jyoti faces embarrassment for her English at her child's school.

videos.title: Jyoti Gains Popularity
videos.overview: Jyoti gains popularity by sharing share market tips with the school's parent group, but Sakhi is concerned as she believes she shouldn't provide such advice because she's not authorised to do so.

videos.title: Jyoti Ki Guarantee
videos.overview: Jyoti gets upset when Sakhi doubts her ability to give share market tips. Jyoti's tip backfires, and all the shares drop drastically in value. All the parents from the parent's group arrive at her house to demand their money back.

videos.title: Harshad Ko Mile New Clients
videos.overview: Harshad admits to helping Jyoti and takes the blame and later reveals his profit motive to Dakshesh. Later, Sakhi is in a bad mood on Valentine's Day.

videos.title: Made For Each Other
videos.overview: Sakhi feels for Vivaan when she takes Vivaan's girlfriend's interview for Valentine's Day. Meanwhile, Karen comes back to meet Sakhi.

videos.title: Karen Ko Wapas Nahi Jana
videos.overview: The Wagle family learns that Karen wants to marry Sakhi but the family aims to convince him to return to Germany. Meanwhile, Anvita quarrels with Vivaan on Valentine's Day and asks him if he loves Sakhi.

videos.title: Karen Is Going Back
videos.overview: Sakhi tells Karen that she doesn't love him and requests him to go back to Germany. During their conversation, Karen inadvertently leaves his ring at Sakhi's place. Karen tells Sakhi that Vivaan has genuine feelings for her. Later, Asha organizes two helpers to support Vandana in efficiently handling her responsibilities.

videos.title: Rajesh Gets A Job Opportunity
videos.overview: Manocha, a P2P Max client reconnects with Rajesh. Rajesh reveals his departure reasons to Manocha. Later, Manocha agrees to do business with P2P Max only on the condition that Rajesh joins P2P Max again.

videos.title: Srinivas Ka Swabhimaan
videos.overview: Srinivas scolds Harshad in front of his client, and his client decides to cancel his deal with Harshad. Meanwhile, Vandana gets a notice from the society members against her home kitchen. What will happen now?

videos.title: Rajesh Challenges Harry
videos.overview: Mr. Walia opposes Vandana working from home, and she assures him of having only three workers. Rajesh discovers Harry and Manocha joining forces, and he challenges Harry to ensure P2P Max's victory over their company.

videos.title: Rajesh Takes Charge
videos.overview: Dasani warns Rajesh that matching Harry's company prices would cause a loss for P2P Max. Rajesh takes charge of P2P Max's operations. Later, Manoj complains to Jyoti about his job and Anvita insults Manoj.

videos.title: Vandana Needs More Helpers
videos.overview: Vandana asks Dakshesh for help in hiring additional helpers, but he can't assist. Meanwhile, at P2P Max, a worker shares job insecurity concerns with Rajesh. Finding no aid from Yamini and Jyoti, Vandana later receives two workers arranged by Dakshesh.

videos.title: Padosi Ki Madad
videos.overview: Walia stirs trouble at Vandana's house, suspecting she has kept more than three helpers. Vandana clarifies the identities of the other two workers. Mangesh manipulates Harshad against Srinivas, while Manoj and Vidya get into a fight.

videos.title: Manoj Insults Harshad
videos.overview: Harshad, upset with Srinivas over an alleged tip to the income tax department, creates a scene at his house. In the confrontation, Manoj insults Harshad. To settle the dispute with P2P Max, Harry demands a written apology from Rajesh. Rajesh reveals his plan to colleagues and bosses.

videos.title: Harshad Ki Galati
videos.overview: Harshad speaks rudely to Srinivas as he thinks that he called the income tax officer to report him. Rajesh gets angry when he sees Harshad disrespecting Srinivas. What will he do now?

videos.title: Harshad Apologises To Srinivas
videos.overview: Rajesh reassures Harry about P2P Max's profit and unveils his plan. Harshad apologizes to Srinivas, acknowledging there was no betrayal. Meanwhile, Jyoti, anxious about a potential pregnancy, decides to take a test.

videos.title: Pregnancy Ka Darr
videos.overview: Jyoti worries Radhika might see the ordered pregnancy kit, mistakenly delivered to Mangesh. The Wagles gather for game night, where a drunken Manoj expresses his desire to become a father, while Vidya prefers avoiding the pregnancy topic.

videos.title: Vidya's Pregnancy News Spreads
videos.overview: The Wagle family suspects Jyoti might be pregnant. Vandana and Vidya visit a gynaecologist to confirm Vidya's pregnancy, with Vidya urging Vandana to keep it confidential. Despite their efforts, the news spreads, and everyone finds out.

videos.title: Sabko Hai Khabar
videos.overview: Manoj reveals his impending fatherhood to Sakhi's friends. The doctor informs Vidya of her pregnancy, and she's surprised to learn that everyone already knows and is congratulating her.

videos.title: Radhika Blames Vandana
videos.overview: Vidya decides not to have the child, and Vandana says she'll support her. Radhika overhears their conversation. Later, Vidya goes to the hospital without informing anyone, and Radhika blames Vandana for influencing Vidya's decision.

videos.title: Vidya's Choice
videos.overview: The Wagle family members discuss what Vidya should do about her pregnancy. Radhika understands Vandana's point of view and decides to give Vidya the choice. What will Vidya choose?

videos.title: Diamonds Ki Safety
videos.overview: Rajesh reveals information about his company's 3 crore diamond package to the family, expressing worry over its safety. Meanwhile, Dakshesh seeks Vandana's help to curb noise pollution caused by his wife's dancing with ghungroo on.

videos.title: Diamonds In Danger
videos.overview: P2P Max's employees safeguard the diamonds at night. Yamini suspects Rajesh of hiding her ghungroo in his office. Later, a masked intruder with a gun enters P2P Max, aiming to steal the precious diamonds.

videos.title: Ek Majboor Insaan
videos.overview: A man attempts to rob P2P Max with a gun. Dakshesh and Harshad join Rajesh in persuading the masked assailant to surrender. Police arrive promptly. Later, the masked man reveals his motive to Rajesh.

videos.title: Women's Day Celebration Planning
videos.overview: Sakhi and Vandana explain to Yamini and Jyoti that Padma Shree winners are everyday people doing exceptional work. The kids plan a Women's Day celebration, contemplating an award for the most outstanding woman. Who will get this award?

videos.title: Sabke Liye Awards Hai
videos.overview: The women eagerly anticipate winning the Best Women's Award, driven by a desire for recognition. During the Women's Day celebration, each is honored with awards tailored to their individual achievements.

videos.title: Inspiring Women Of Sai Darshan Heights Society
videos.overview: Vandana gets awarded the Ultimate Fighter award for winning her battle against cancer. Later, Rajesh presents special awards to Sakhi, Kiara, and Kittu as well. All the audience members are inspired by listening to the award speeches of all the winners.

videos.title: Group Chat
videos.overview: Caught in the crossfire of Harshad and Dakshesh's quarrel in the group chat, Rajesh finds himself stuck. Meanwhile, Sakhi fires away questions at Vandana for her podcast, and Vandana gets a bit anxious, fearing Rajesh might be ignoring her.

videos.title: Rajesh's Controversial Messages
videos.overview: Rajesh feels guilty for calling Dakshesh lazy. Manoj praises Rajesh's playful texts to the family, but Rajesh is clueless. Later, he discovers the content of his messages.

videos.title: Dakshesh Ne Diya Solution
videos.overview: Rajesh is mortified by his message in the family chat. Dakshesh suggests flooding the group with other messages to bury Rajesh's message. Will it work?

videos.title: Sab Normal Act Karo
videos.overview: Rajesh’s family finds out about Rajesh’s inappropriate messages on the group chat. Later, Vandana and Sakhi come up with plans to make Rajesh confess what he did.

videos.title: Mard Ko Dard Hota Hai
videos.overview: Vidyut gets scared to tell Harshad that he loves poetry. Vidyut has to spend a night in a juvenile home. Later, to avoid coming across as weak, Vidyut doesn't accept credit for his poem in class.

videos.title: Vidyut's Poem
videos.overview: Rajesh finds out that Harshad has a deep-rooted gender bias. Atharva is unable to tell Ishita the truth about the poem. Everyone tries to convince Harshad to go to the juvenile home to rescue Vidyut. However, Harshad is unable to put his male ego aside and show his emotional side.

videos.title: P2P Is Haunted?
videos.overview: Rajesh gets a very troubling call from Atharva. Rajesh chooses to take his family on vacation while his coworkers believe that P2P Max's storage room is haunted.

videos.title: Rajesh Ko Hua Doubt
videos.overview: When a man retrieves his phone from P2P Max, Rajesh suspects something is wrong with him. After speaking with Atharva, Rajesh discovers that their courier service is being misused. Who is carrying this out?

videos.title: Vivaan And Sakhi's Adventure
videos.overview: Rajesh approaches Sakhi to get help finding a phone number. Vivaan and Sakhi install a recorder in Tonki's house. Subsequently, Rajesh finds out that the Beauty Gloss Cosmetics lab is creating a dangerous virus.

videos.title: Quarantine Karna Hoga
videos.overview: Rajesh and the police catch Tonki. When Rajesh puts work ahead of their vacation, Atharva loses his�cool. Later, Rajesh and the team are asked to quarantine in the office by the police as they may be infected with the virus.

videos.title: Awareness Is Power
videos.overview: Goons create chaos at Sakhi's office. Later, Rajesh discovers contaminated face creams have been distributed in the market. What will Rajesh do next?

videos.title: Holi Ki Galati
videos.overview: Harshad, Rajesh and Dakshesh get shut out by their family members for doing something questionable during the Holi function. However, three of them don't have a clue about what they did. Will they find out the truth?

videos.title: Garden Band Hai
videos.overview: Rajesh regrets his insensitive comments about Vandana and his children and seeks to apologize. Later, Dakshesh enforces a temporary ban on entry into the society.

videos.title: Jhula Kisne Todha?
videos.overview: Dakshesh inaugurates the garden with the kids. Walia breaks the rule but refuses to pay the fine. Later, Dakshesh reveals that someone broke the swing in the garden.

videos.title: Who Broke The Swing?
videos.overview: Dakshesh reviews CCTV footage to catch the swing breaker. Srinivas claims to have witnessed the incident, prompting a society meeting to unveil the truth.

videos.title: Mata Aur Pita Ka Role
videos.overview: Kittu feels embarrassed by her tiffin in front of her friends and asks Yamini to quit her job. Dakshesh looks after Kittu while Yamini continues working, leading Kittu to speak rudely to Dakshesh.

videos.title: Kittu Is Embarrassed
videos.overview: Dakshesh messes up Kittu's makeup before her function, causing embarrassment. Upset, Kittu decides to stay at Vandana's. Later, everyone attends Kittu’s Elocution contest. Will Dakshesh show up?

videos.title: Best Husband In The World
videos.overview: Rajesh seeks Dakshesh and Harshad's advice to come up with a surprise for Vandana on their marriage anniversary. However, Vandana thinks that Rajesh has forgotten about their anniversary. What will Rajesh do now?

videos.title: Surprise Or No Surprise?
videos.overview: Vandana eagerly awaits a surprise from Rajesh on their anniversary, but feels let down when nothing happens. Atharva and Sakhi step in to uncover Rajesh's plans for Vandana.

videos.title: Mumbai Ki Air Quality
videos.overview: Rajesh impresses the client and considers buying an air purifier for his family after learning about the poor air quality in their locality. Later, Sakhi informs Rajesh about the poor air quality specifically in their neighbourhood.

videos.title: Relationships Or Duty?
videos.overview: Harshad advises Sakhi to remove her video exposing the powerful builder, revealing his own investment in the project. Sakhi is left to decide whether to comply with his request or stand by her principles.

videos.title: Saas Lena Hai Mushkil
videos.overview: Rajesh apologizes to Sakhi and pledges his support. Dakshesh proposes to file Public Interest Litigation against Goradia and Shah builders, but Harshad declines. Later, Vidyut struggles to breathe, experiencing coughing fits.

videos.title: Farewell Aa Raha Hai
videos.overview: Aditya refuses to help Harshad, causing Vidyut's health to worsen and making Harshad realize his mistake. Meanwhile, Atharva and his friends recall their upcoming farewell and talk about the school uniform.

videos.title: Atharva's School Farewell Party
videos.overview: Rajesh gives his old coat to Atharva for the farewell. Atharva is worried about how Ruchita will react after seeing his coat. Meanwhile, Rajesh shares his schooltime stories with his friends.

videos.title: Atharva Ka Purana Coat
videos.overview: Atharva recites a moving poem at the farewell. Vandana and Rajesh fondly recall school memories with friends. However, unkind remarks about Atharva's coat cast a shadow over the evening's spirit.

videos.title: Bye Bye Mosquitoes
videos.overview: Dakshesh is offering a 25,000 rupee reward for the best idea to eradicate mosquitoes. Who will give the best idea?

videos.title: Tiwari Jaata Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Harshad warns Dakshesh about the harmful effects of the 'Go Macchar Go' spray on animals as well as humans. Meanwhile, Rajesh investigates where Tiwari goes at night instead of fulfilling his responsibilities.

videos.title: Rajesh Se Hui Galti
videos.overview: Rajesh confronts a fruit vendor after getting scammed but later can't find him to apologize. Meanwhile, Manoj suspects Mangesh of stealing Radhika's gold chain.

videos.title: Rajesh Ka Guilt
videos.overview: Rajesh feels guilty for wrongly accusing a man and tries to reach out to him. He scolds Dasani for mocking the poor fruit vendor. Later, Rajesh then rushes to the market to apologize to the vendor.

videos.title: Football Match And Board Exams
videos.overview: Rajesh helps find the fruit vendor's mobile phone by using social media. Atharva injures his leg while playing football. Vandana and Rajesh forbid him from playing again till his board exams. What will Atharva do now?

videos.title: Atharva Is Injured
videos.overview: Atharva lies about studying and goes to play football. Rajesh and Vandana catch him in the lie. Unfortunately, Atharva gets injured and now can't take his board exams. What happens next?

videos.title: Vaibhav's Real Intentions
videos.overview: Atharva's principal assigns Vaibhav as his exam writer. Atharva suspects Vaibhav's motives and discusses with Manoj, who suggests a plan to deal with Vaibhav.

videos.title: Atharva Ka Exam
videos.overview: Atharva gets ready for his exam with Rajesh's trust in him. Atharva questions why Vaibhav didn't seek revenge. Meanwhile, Vandana makes ladoos for everyone.

videos.title: Voting Is Important
videos.overview: Harshad tells Srinivas about government benefits for lower-class individuals. Vandana and Rajesh feel that today's youth don't grasp the importance of voting. Rajesh then organizes elections in Sai Darshan society.

videos.title: Election Fever
videos.overview: Election fever grips Sai Darshan society as the candidates lay out their manifestos and visions for the future. With three diverse candidates offering distinct plans, the society members face a crucial decision. Who will win their votes?

videos.title: Importance Of Discipline
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana tell everyone about the importance of voting through the mock elections at Sai Darshan Heights Society. Meanwhile, Rajesh decides to bring some discipline back to Atharva's life during his vacations. What will he do?

videos.title: Atharva's Internship
videos.overview: Atharva doesn't want to intern during his vacation at Rajesh's office, but Rajesh tempts him with his favourite video game. Rajesh instructs everyone not to show Atharva any special treatment. Later, Atharva complains to Vidyut about the difficulties he faced at Rajesh's office.

videos.title: Kaam Ki Value
videos.overview: Vandana and Sakhi miss Atharva at home. Rajesh advises Atharva on managing personal and professional life. Atharva finds his favorite video game in a package at P2P Max. Later, Rajesh catches Atharva lying.

videos.title: Atharva Ne Chori Kari?
videos.overview: A man reports his grandson's undelivered order to P2P Max. Rajesh worries about Atharva, suspecting trouble. Meanwhile, Nick accuses Atharva of theft, and Atharva goes missing. What happens next?

videos.title: Komal's Big Achievement
videos.overview: Asha feels inadequate compared to parents who provide more for their children. Meanwhile, Komal wins a topper award and a scholarship at school. To celebrate, Asha throws a party at her house.

videos.title: Celebration For Komal
videos.overview: Members of the Sai Darshan Heights Society arrive at Asha's house to congratulate her and celebrate her success. Meanwhile, Asha's husband, Dilip, feels undermined by all the other guests.

videos.title: Izzat Ki Bhook
videos.overview: Rajesh finds out that Dilip and Asha's self-respect has been hurt due to the members of Sai Darshan Heights. He calls Vandana and the others back to Asha's house to make things right.

videos.title: Srinivas' Heart Problem
videos.overview: The doctor tells Srinivas he has heart problems, but Manoj and Srinivas feel the recommended tests are too expensive and unnecessary. Srinivas asks Manoj and Harshad to keep it a secret from the family. What will happen when the family finds out?

videos.title: Operation Ke Liye Paise
videos.overview: The doctor tells Srinivas' sons that he needs urgent heart surgery due to a serious blockage. Rajesh and Vandana scramble to gather funds for the operation. Will they raise enough money in time?

videos.title: Radhika Ko Jhooth Bolna Padha
videos.overview: Manoj and Vidya give 3 lakh rupees for Srinivas' operation. Rajesh asks Harshad for a loan to cover the rest. Later, Srinivas lies to Radhika about going on a trip with friends.

videos.title: Recording Mein Sach Pakda Gaya
videos.overview: Srinivas messages Radhika about his enjoyable trip. Meanwhile, Sakhi hears a nurse's recording and urges Vandana to stop Srinivas' surgery. What does the nurse reveal in the recording?

videos.title: Corrupt Doctors
videos.overview: The Wagle family plans to confront Srinivas' corrupt doctor. With Kiara and Dakshesh's help, Rajesh exposes the doctor's unethical behaviour. Later, Sakhi discusses her documentary idea titled 'Medical Industry: Business or Service?' with Rajesh.

videos.title: The New Form Of Communication
videos.overview: Sakhi takes help from Vivaan to find the topic of her next article. Later, Rajesh decides to go to a client's office to clear up the miscommunication caused by Dasani. What will he do?

videos.title: Kadambari Ki Majboori
videos.overview: Kadambari’s sons are taken aback when she informs them about the lingering family loan she has been tirelessly trying to pay off for years. How will they react to this?

videos.title: Rajesh's Important Deal
videos.overview: Kadambari reveals she came to give money to her sons, not to take from them, and decides to give it to Vandana instead. Later, Rajesh grows nervous about an upcoming important meeting.

videos.title: Rajesh Ke Joote
videos.overview: Rajesh's shoes get stolen at a temple, causing stress as he's running late for a crucial meeting. Meanwhile, P2P Max's key clients are upset by the company's unprofessional behaviour. What will Rajesh do next?

videos.title: Yamini And Dakshesh's Fight
videos.overview: After a fight with Yamini, Dakshesh decides to leave home. Yamini expresses her disappointment to her friends about Dakshesh missing her special event and lying to her. Dakshesh then chooses to spend the night sleeping in the park. What will happen next?

videos.title: Battle Of Egos
videos.overview: Dakshesh starts staying at Rajesh's house after getting into a fight with Yamini. Later, Harshad and Jyoti come up with an idea to resolve Dakshesh and Yamini's fight. Will their plan work?

videos.title: Vandana And Rajesh's Fight
videos.overview: Sakhi and Atharva share with Srinivas and Radhika that Rajesh and Vandana are upset with each other. They all work together to arrange a meeting for Rajesh and Vandana, to help them reconcile. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Dilip Kya Kaam Karta Hai?
videos.overview: Rajesh suspects Asha's husband, Dilip, of suspicious behaviour. When Asha confronts Dilip, he reacts defensively. Sakhi tells Vivaan she'll maintain her distance from him in front of Anvita. Later, everyone begins to suspect Dilip of fraud.

videos.title: Dilip Majboor Hai
videos.overview: Rajesh discovers that Dilip once sought his help but was unable to meet him due to colleagues' interference. Dilip urges Asha to quit working at Vandana's place. Later, Dilip confides in Manoj that he is not proud of his current job.

videos.title: Kishori Ki Tips
videos.overview: Dilip explains how he resorted to begging and got involved with Monty, who controls the beggars. Dilip mentions that he helped Manoj find a job. Later, Radhika's friend advises her to encourage more romance from Srinivas and gives her tips.

videos.title: I Love You Boldo
videos.overview: Sakhi and her friends aim to rekindle Radhika and Srinivas' romance. While Srinivas hesitates to say "I love you," Sakhi and Vivaan work to bring them closer and, in the process, grow closer themselves.

videos.title: Dakshesh Ka Naya Rule
videos.overview: Sakhi and Vivaan give Srinivas an idea to impress Radhika. Later, Dakshesh comes up with a new rule for all society members.

videos.title: Kon Hai Chess Ka Expert?
videos.overview: Jyoti boasts about her chess skills, defeating Harshad. Srinivas shares chess history. Then, Tiwari and Dakshesh face off in a match. Who will win?

videos.title: Tiwari Aur Dakshesh Ka Match
videos.overview: Dakshesh loses a chess game to Tiwari but claims it was intentional and demands a rematch. Manoj challenges Dakshesh to resign from the society's secretary post if he loses again, while Walia challenges Tiwari to quit his job if he loses to Dakshesh.

videos.title: Dilip Kya Chhupa Raha Hai?
videos.overview: Tiwari wins against Dakshesh but sets a condition. Asha tells Vandana about Dilip's bad dreams. Later, Sakhi tries to uncover what Rajesh and Vandana are hiding from Asha.

videos.title: Manners And Etiquettes
videos.overview: Rajesh's friend, Colonel Ashish Singh, moves to Mumbai. Inspired by him, Rajesh starts emulating his sophisticated lifestyle and behaviour, coaching his family accordingly. However, his family finds his sudden change in demeanour odd.

videos.title: Rajesh's Bootcamp
videos.overview: Rajesh plans a bootcamp for his family and neighbours, covering table manners, discipline, and fitness. Will they embrace his strict programme or rebel against his latest obsession?

videos.title: Civilian Fauji
videos.overview: Rajesh apologizes to his family members for being too strict with them. Everyone decides to help Rajesh in impressing his friend Ashish. However, they are left shocked when Ashish arrives at Rajesh's house for dinner.

videos.title: Goa Trip With Friends
videos.overview: Sakhi and her friends plan a trip, but she opts out due to the cost. Vivaan then tells her the college is taking everyone to Goa. Later, Sakhi and her friends start preparing for the trip.

videos.title: Sakhi Wants To Go Back
videos.overview: Sakhi and her friends arrive at their hotel in Goa, where Vivaan admits he lied about the college trip. Gungun asks Sakhi to stay and keep it a secret. Later, a situation forces the girls and boys to share a room.

videos.title: Jhooth Pakda Gaya
videos.overview: Gungun's boyfriend tries to get close to her, but Vivaan stops him. Mangesh reveals that Sakhi and Gungun lied about the college trip to Goa. What will happen now?

videos.title: Mangesh Ne Kari Jasoosi
videos.overview: Gungun feels bad seeing Shikhar flirt with other girls. Sakhi senses someone watching them. Later, Rishi misbehaves with Sakhi.

videos.title: Sakhi In Danger
videos.overview: Sakhi tells Vivaan to prioritize Anvita and make her feel secure. Later, Sakhi starts drowning in the ocean, and her friends try to save her. Will she be alright?

videos.title: Sakhi Kuch Chupa Rahi Hai
videos.overview: Vandana and Rajesh find out that Sakhi almost drowned while swimming in the ocean. Later, Sakhi gets drunk and video calls her parents.

videos.title: Nanhe Mobile Stars
videos.overview: Sakhi and her family are shocked when Kittu's meaningless poem goes viral. Media expert Mr. Srivastav promises to make Kittu a superstar and urges her to upload another video within the hour. What will happen next?

videos.title: Kittu Ke Jhooth
videos.overview: Kittu lies about her parents' constant fighting but still makes it to 'Nanhe Mobile Stars.' In the next round, she lies again. Later, Dakshesh wants her to quit the show. Will he succeed in convincing her?

videos.title: Manoj Se Paise Ghum Gaye
videos.overview: Kittu confesses the truth to the judges, expressing her love for her parents. Manoj admits he lost his boss's money. What happens next?

videos.title: Manoj In Trouble
videos.overview: Manoj lands in hot water with his boss after losing company funds. His family rallies around him, offering support, but can he recover from this financial fiasco?

videos.title: Manoj's Mystery Gets Solved
videos.overview: Manoj discovers that his family has secretly helped him by anonymously giving money. But the truth behind the lost funds is finally revealed, changing everything.

videos.title: Atharva Ki Nayi Soch
videos.overview: Atharva gets inspired after reading about the struggles of freedom fighters in India. Later, Atharva tells his family that he wants to get married. What will happen now?

videos.title: Atharva Ki Shaadi
videos.overview: The entire family is in a state of shock as Rajesh accepts Atharva's demands to get married. Has Atharva really convinced him or does Rajesh have a plan in mind?

videos.title: Atharva Ko Karni Hai Shaadi
videos.overview: Vandana tells Atharva to pay rent or leave. Rajesh asks him to choose a bride. Later, Atharva proposes to Ruchita. How will she react?

videos.title: Vidya Ka Checkup
videos.overview: Manoj tells Vadnana that Vidya missed her doctor's appointment. During her checkup, they find a male gynecologist has replaced her usual one. Later, Vidya gathers everyone to share some news.

videos.title: Vidya Ki Report
videos.overview: Mangesh scolds Manoj for mistreating Vidya, who is anxious about her test results. Later, Vandana and Vidya are surprised by the results and share good news with everyone. What is the good news?

videos.title: Mangesh Is Missing
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana suspect something is wrong and hire Asha to investigate. Meanwhile, Vidya is worried because Mangesh is missing. Where is Mangesh?

videos.title: Mangesh Mil Gaya
videos.overview: Asha announces that Vidya is expecting twins. Manoj discovers Mangesh's location and feels bad for not finding him first. Later, Manoj suggests impractical changes to prepare for the babies.

videos.title: Manoj Pe Shak
videos.overview: Vidya worries about his faithfulness. Vandana & Rajesh lend a helping hand, digging deep to uncover the truth and put her mind at ease.

videos.title: Unpaid Maternity Leave
videos.overview: Vidya is shocked and outraged when her employers inform her that she's being put on unpaid maternity leave, assuming she can't handle the workload. How will she fight back against this discriminatory decision?

videos.title: Donation Deke Admission
videos.overview: Atharva and Vidyut face a dilemma as admission season approaches. Harshad pushes for donation-based admission to secure a spot in a top college.

videos.title: Dasani Ki Shaadi
videos.overview: Dasani meets a girl for an arranged marriage setup, but the girl takes offence to something he says and leaves in a huff. What did Dasani say to upset her?

videos.title: Dasani In Trouble
videos.overview: Colony residents are stunned and amused by Sonakshi's lawsuit against Dasani. The community is deeply divided, sparking a heated debate on harassment vs harmless words.

videos.title: Out Or Not Out
videos.overview: Atharva and Vidyut have a fall while they are playing cricket. Rajesh confronts Atharva for fighting with Vidyut. Later, Rajesh gets a scolding in the office for coming late. How will Rajesh deal with Vidyut and Atharva's fight?

videos.title: Saving Sanjay
videos.overview: Rajesh bumps into Sanjay's mother at the hospital and learns that his friend has been injured and urgently needs blood for surgery. With time running out, Rajesh takes on the challenge of arranging for a crucial blood transfusion.

videos.title: Atharva Starts College
videos.overview: Senior Wagle plans a grand celebration before Atharva's college starts, causing him embarrassment and prompting him to ask Rajesh for help to stop it. Will he be able to?

videos.title: Atharva's First Day Of College
videos.overview: Atharva is thrilled to start his college journey, eager to embrace new experiences. However, his parents, Rajesh and Vandan, can't shake off their worries about his well-being

videos.title: Ragging Ka Asar
videos.overview: Rajesh and Vandana are anxious about Atharva's safety in college, fearing he might be facing ragging.

videos.title: Manoj's Antics
videos.overview: Manoj gets drunk and makes a reckless move: he verbally lashes out at his boss over the phone and calls up his shady friends. But will he wake up to regret and face the consequences of his actions in the morning?

videos.title: Increment Or Resignation?
videos.overview: Rajesh makes up his mind to approach his boss for a salary increase.. Before the crucial meeting, he has a final discussion with Vandana. Will Rajesh secure the increment he desires, or will he opt for resignation?

videos.title: Manoj Ki Rickshaw
videos.overview: Vandana and Rajesh get into Manoj's rickshaw, not knowing he's working extra jobs to support his pregnant partner.

videos.title: Vidya Ki Naukri
videos.overview: Vidya's desire to work and support her growing family sparks tension with Radhika, who opposes the idea. How will Vidya react to this?

videos.title: Vidya Gets Hospitalised
videos.overview: Vidya is hospitalised with food poisoning, and Radhika blames herself for the incident, believing she may have inadvertently caused her emergency.

videos.title: New Girl In Class
videos.overview: A new girl joins Atharva's class, and all the boys like her. Meanwhile, the seniors plan a party for new students.

videos.title: Atharva Gets Into Trouble
videos.overview: Atharva gets into trouble for proposing to a girl his seniors forced him to. Meanwhile, Vidyut's girlfriend refuses to admit that they're a couple.

videos.title: Goodness Comes Back
videos.overview: A delivery boy returns to give back the money to Vandana, thanking her for raising a complaint and also helping them with their food deliveries. Later, Sakhi encourages Vandana to stand up for herself.

videos.title: Rajesh Loses His Phone
videos.overview: Rajesh returns from a crucial meeting, only to realize he has misplaced his phone containing vital data and passwords. Panicked, he searches everywhere, hoping to recover his phone.

videos.title: Dakshesh's Brilliant Idea
videos.overview: Rajesh's phone has gone missing, and everyone's in a state of panic! The family's brainstorming ways to retrieve it, but Dakshesh has come up with a brilliant plan to outsmart the thief.

videos.title: Sakhi's Assignment
videos.overview: Sakhi receives an assignment from her college to write an essay about the woman who inspires her the most. Who will she choose?

videos.title: Seven Wonders Of Sakhi's Life
videos.overview: Sakhi concludes her essay by paying a heartfelt tribute to the seven incredible women who have made a lasting impact on her life.

videos.title: Momo Party
videos.overview: Vandana and the ladies are on a mission to satisfy their cravings. They're searching for the famous momo stall but he has shifted his location. Will they find him?

videos.title: Maa Baap Ka Farz
videos.overview: Rajesh consoles Dipinder Mama, assuring him that his son loves him. Later, Rajesh brings momos for everyone to enjoy.

videos.title: Tote Ki Delivery
videos.overview: Dassani's careless mistake sets off a chain reaction of chaos. The parrot meant for delivery escapes from its cage, sending the customer into a fury.

videos.title: Atharva's Change In Attitude
videos.overview: Atharva decides to run for the Division Representative post in college, but the pressure of the election campaign leads to stress and he lashes out at Rajesh and Sakhi.

videos.title: College Elections
videos.overview: Atharva delivers his speech, emphasizing the importance of academic excellence and presenting a strong case for his candidacy. By prioritizing academics over Abhimanyu's popularity, Atharva takes a bold stance.

videos.title: Bike Ride
videos.overview: Gungun faces relationship troubles with her boyfriend, creating an opportunity for Mangesh to step in and offer his support. However, Sakhi intervenes, warning Gungun and urging her to steer clear of Mangesh.

videos.title: Mangesh Lashes Out
videos.overview: Mangesh confronts Manoj in front of everyone, accusing him of attempting to take his property. Simultaneously, Vidya discovers that Mangesh has returned home intoxicated.

videos.title: Rishton Ka Badlaav
videos.overview: The members of society urge Rajesh to reconsider keeping Mangesh with him. Later, they learn that Mangesh has been summoned to the police station. What has Mangesh done to attract police attention?

videos.title: Atharva Feels Guilty
videos.overview: Atharva grapples with guilt after accidentally damaging his classmate's tablet, while Rajesh lands in the police station due to traffic violations.

videos.title: Rajesh Wants To Break Free
videos.overview: Tired of the restrictions of his middle-class life, Rajesh decides to change his outlook. But as his family members begin to notice the shifts in his behaviour, concern starts to grow among them.

videos.title: Rajesh Tries His Luck
videos.overview: Rajesh accompanies Dilip and observes people buying lottery tickets and celebrating their wins. Intrigued by the excitement, Dilip persuades Rajesh to take a chance.

videos.title: Jackpot Ki Khoj
videos.overview: Rajesh returns to the counter, intent on winning the jackpot this time. As he tries his luck again, could this be slowly becoming an addiction?

videos.title: Baarish Ke Maze
videos.overview: Sakhi and her friends find themselves stranded on the road with no cabs in sight, but Vivaan comes to the rescue, offering to pick them up. Meanwhile, the family members stay indoors, playing games and enjoying the rainy day.

videos.title: Vidya's Emergency
videos.overview: Vidya suddenly starts feeling weak and calls Vandana for help. Vandana checks in on her and tries to make sense of her situation and comes to the conclusion that she has Gestational diabetes.

videos.title: Mangesh Returns
videos.overview: Mangesh comes back and opens up to his mother about feeling overlooked by his family and the lack of closeness with anyone. Meanwhile, Sakhi confides in Vandana about the intricate dynamics between Gungun and Mangesh.

videos.title: Journey Of The Middle-Class
videos.overview: Rajesh and the other members of the colony feel a shift in the air as the challenges of middle-class life weigh down on them, prompting a collective search for ways to hustle and bring about change in their lives.

videos.title: Dakshesh Takes Up A Cause
videos.overview: Dakshesh's assistant motivates him to enhance his financial situation, leading him to speak up against the polluted drains in his neighbourhood.

videos.title: Dakshesh Gets Beaten Up
videos.overview: Rajesh and Harshad begin to question Dakshesh and his intentions behind his protest. When they confront him, a group of goons suddenly appear and attack Dakshesh.

videos.title: Khargosh Ki Chaal
videos.overview: Rajesh undergoes a change in attitude as he starts splurging his money and living a lifestyle that Vandana doesn't appreciate.

videos.title: Vandana Arranges A House Party
videos.overview: Vandana is devastated to find out that Rajesh has been secretly funding the change in Atharva's wardrobe. Later, Vandana arranges a house party.

videos.title: Vandana Investigates
videos.overview: Vandana grows increasingly curious about where Rajesh got the money and begins to investigate the matter herself. Meanwhile, Rajesh does his best to avoid both her questions and the topic altogether.

videos.title: Vandana Finds Out
videos.overview: Vandana discovers Rajesh's obsession with the lottery and confronts him, her disbelief evident and trust shattered.

videos.title: Rajesh Loses It All
videos.overview: Rajesh confides in Atharva about his gambling addiction. Later, he discovers he’s lost all the money he invested in lottery tickets.

videos.title: Fixed Deposit
videos.overview: Vandana decides to break the fixed deposit to fund the bathroom repairs. Little does she know, Rajesh has already cashed it out and squandered the money on lottery tickets.

videos.title: Mangesh Gets Suspicious
videos.overview: Mangesh grows suspicious when he sees Rajesh selling jewellery. Will Rajesh be able to evade Mangesh's probing questions?

videos.title: Duniya Gol Hain
videos.overview: Vandana discovers that Rajesh has been gambling once more. He attempts to explain himself, but Vandana refuses to listen. Will she find it in her heart to forgive him?

videos.title: Rajesh Aur Vandana Ka Jhagda

videos.overview: The big day finally arrives for Sakhi and Vivaan, but Rajesh is still grappling with his concerns about the engagement. Will the engagement go ahead as planned or hit another hurdle?

videos.overview: Manoj and Radhika secretly plan Sakhi and Vivaan's court wedding, hoping to avoid more drama. But things get tense when Harshad catches wind of their plan. Will he expose them?

videos.overview: Rajesh plans a family trip to Mahabaleshwar, but Radhika is unhappy. She's still fixated on getting Sakhi and Vivaan married. Will she find a way to stop the trip?
